While we’ve implemented protections, they aren’t foolproof. Attack vectors are constantly evolving and Claude may hallucinate, leading to actions that you did not intend. We’ve shared our testing results, including possible attack scenarios, so you can make informed decisions, and strongly encourage you to <risksLink>read about the risks</risksLink> before using this product. <blogLink>Read blog post</blogLink>

original:
Help me organize recent screenshots on my Desktop.

First, scan my Desktop and count how many screenshots/images are there. Show me:
- Total count
- Date range (oldest to newest)

Then, focus only on screenshots from the last 14 days. For each one:
- Identify what it shows
- Suggest a descriptive filename
- Propose which folder it belongs in (or if it can be deleted)

Group similar screenshots together. Show me the plan before making any changes.

After I approve, start by organizing just 10 files as a preview. If there are more than 10 files, check in with me before continuing with the rest.

- 总数
- 日期范围（最旧到最新）

然后，仅关注过去 14 天的屏幕截图。对于每一个：
- 识别它显示的内容
- 建议一个描述性文件名
- 建议它属于哪个文件夹（或者是否可以删除）

将相似的屏幕截图分组在一起。在进行任何更改之前先向我展示计划。

original:
Help me organize and clean up my email inbox.

First, scan my inbox and show me a summary:
- Total unread emails
- Emails older than 30 days
- The main senders or types of emails

Before organizing, ask me:
- What categories or folders I want to create
- Which types of emails I want to archive or delete
- Whether there are specific senders I want to prioritize or filter
- Any email patterns I want to address (newsletters, promotions, etc.)

Focus only on emails older than 30 days first — these are easiest to clean up. Show me a proposed plan:
- Which emails to archive
- Which to delete
- Which need action

If there are more than 50 old emails, start with a batch of 20 so I can check your approach. Once I approve, process that batch.
translation:
帮助我整理和清理我的邮件收件箱。

首先，扫描我的收件箱并向我显示摘要：
- 未读邮件总数
- 超过 30 天的邮件
- 邮件的主要发件人或类型

在组织之前，问我：
- 我想创建哪些类别或文件夹
- 我想要存档或删除哪些类型的邮件
- 是否有我想要优先考虑或过滤的特定发件人
- 我想要解决的任何邮件模式（时事通讯、促销活动等）

首先仅关注超过 30 天的邮件 - 这些最容易清理。给我展示一个拟议的计划：
- 要存档哪些邮件
- 要删除哪些邮件
- 哪些需要采取行动

如果有超过 50 封旧邮件，请从 20 封开始，以便我检查你的方法。一旦我批准，就处理该批次。

translation: 一个云端会话正在使用这台电脑上的“{folderName}”

original: This extension is disabled by your organization's policy.
translation: 组织策略已禁用此扩展。

original: {folder} is now available from your other devices
translation: 现在可以从其他设备访问 {folder}

original: Found {count, plural, one {# Claude Code session} other {# Claude Code sessions}} on this computer that {count, plural, one {isn''t} other {aren''t}} in your session list. This includes Code tab sessions missing from this app''s list and sessions started from the terminal. It may also include sessions from other copies of Claude installed on this computer, sessions from other organizations, earlier versions of sessions, and sessions you previously deleted. Imported sessions keep their conversation history and the permission mode they last ran with, but archive status and permission grants can''t be restored.
translation: 在这台电脑上发现{count, plural, one {# 个 Claude Code 会话} other {# 个 Claude Code 会话}}，它们{count, plural, one {未} other {未}}出现在会话列表中。其中包括此应用列表中缺失的 Code 标签页会话、从终端启动的会话，也可能包括其他 Claude 安装、其他组织、早期版本及之前已删除的会话。导入的会话会保留对话历史和上次使用的权限模式，但无法恢复归档状态与已授予的权限。

original: Claude couldn't confirm which organization you signed in to. Try signing in again.
translation: Claude 无法确认你登录的组织。请重新登录。

original: You trusted this folder for Claude Code, so it was added to Remote Control. Click to review your folders.
translation: 你已将此文件夹设为 Claude Code 的可信文件夹，因此它已加入远程控制。点击检查文件夹列表。

original: list the sites you’re signed into in {browser}
translation: 列出你在 {browser} 中已登录的网站

original: New session for “{title}”, or do it here?
translation: 为“{title}”新建会话，还是在这里处理？

original: The code has been copied to your clipboard.
Enter your security key PIN in Claude to continue.
translation: 在 Claude 中输入安全密钥 PIN 以继续。

original: This extension isn't signed. Ask your administrator to allow it or install a signed version.
translation: 此扩展没有签名。请让管理员允许使用，或安装已签名的版本。

original: Screenshots are sent to Anthropic and kept according to your normal conversation retention settings.
translation: 屏幕截图会发送至 Anthropic，并按照通常的对话保留设置保存。
在文件资源管理器中显示日志

original: Your organization has configured a maximum version of Claude as {maxVersion}. You are on version {currentVersion}. Please contact your organization admin to resolve.
translation: 组织将 Claude 的最高版本设为 {maxVersion}，而你正在使用 {currentVersion}。请联系组织管理员解决。
在另一个应用中打开链接？

original: Sign back in to Claude in Chrome
translation: 在 Chrome 中重新登录 Claude

original: To stay within the folder limit, “{name}” will no longer be listed and its {count, plural, one {# remote session} other {# remote sessions}} will stop.
translation: 为满足文件夹数量限制，“{name}”将不再显示在列表中，其{count, plural, one {# 个远程会话} other {# 个远程会话}}也将停止。

original: Claude Code is running in {folder}. Click to open it.
translation: Claude Code 正在 {folder} 中运行。点击打开。

original: Couldn't save developer settings. Check write access to Claude's settings folder, then try again.
translation: 无法保存开发者设置。请检查 Claude 设置文件夹的写入权限后重试。

original: Restart Claude to apply the change.
translation: 重启 Claude 以应用更改。

original: The access request for {device} couldn't be shown right now; try again shortly.
translation: 目前无法显示 {device} 的访问请求，请稍后重试。

original: Claude won’t open until it can check whether an organization manages this Mac. If your organization manages this Mac, contact your IT administrator.
translation: 确认这台 Mac 是否由组织管理之前，Claude 无法打开。如果此 Mac 由组织管理，请联系 IT 管理员。

original: Cowork isn't running, so there's nothing to clean up right now.
translation: Cowork 未运行，目前没有可清理的内容。

original: Re-pin only if you changed this origin yourself. Afterwards Claude merges protected files (.claude, .mcp.json and similar) into your Code sessions from the new origin's default branch.
translation: 只有在你亲自更改此源地址后，才应重新固定。随后，Claude 会从新源地址的默认分支，将受保护文件（.claude、.mcp.json 等）合并到 Code 会话中。

original: Windows may ask for permission. Running WSL distributions may stop, along with the sessions and apps in them.
translation: Windows 可能会请求权限。正在运行的 WSL 发行版及其中的会话和应用可能会停止。

original: Claude runs in the system tray
translation: Claude 在系统托盘中运行

original: Some sessions were skipped because they are currently running.
translation: 部分会话正在运行，因此已跳过。

original: Claude Code can't open folders on a network share. Copy the folder to this computer and try again.
translation: Claude Code 无法打开网络共享上的文件夹。请将文件夹复制到这台电脑后重试。

original: Cowork isn't available in this build of Claude. Reinstall Claude to use this feature.
translation: 此 Claude 构建不支持 Cowork。请重新安装 Claude 以使用此功能。

original: Claude couldn''t reach the update server. If you''re on a work network, a firewall or proxy may be blocking {hosts} — ask your IT team to allow them. Otherwise, check your connection and try again, or download the latest version from claude.ai/download.
translation: Claude 无法连接更新服务器。如果你使用工作网络，防火墙或代理可能拦截了 {hosts}，请让 IT 团队允许访问。否则，请检查网络后重试，或从 claude.ai/download 下载最新版本。

original: Couldn't open that session. Check your network connection and try again.
translation: 无法打开该会话。请检查网络连接后重试。
继续上次的 Claude Code 会话

original: That folder is already in the list.
This extension can't be verified because its install record couldn't be read.
translation: 无法读取此扩展的安装记录，因此无法验证。

original: Delete Cowork VM bundle and restart?
translation: 删除 Cowork 虚拟机包并重启？
在默认浏览器中打开链接

original: Your home folder, the top level of a disk, and the folders that hold Claude’s own files can’t be added. Choose a project folder instead.
translation: 无法添加主目录、磁盘根目录或存放 Claude 自身文件的文件夹。请选择项目文件夹。

original: Your Google Cloud credentials were rejected. Contact your administrator — they may need to be refreshed.
translation: Google Cloud 凭据被拒绝。请联系管理员，凭据可能需要刷新。

original: It’s already reachable as part of the folder it’s inside. Add it to list it on its own. This also trusts it for Claude Code.
translation: 此文件夹已作为上级文件夹的一部分开放访问。添加后可单独列出，也会将其设为 Claude Code 的可信文件夹。

original: Folders on network locations can’t be added. Choose a folder on this computer.
translation: 无法添加网络位置上的文件夹。请选择这台电脑上的文件夹。

original: Skipped {skipped, plural, one {# session that was} other {# sessions that were}} already in your session list.
translation: 已跳过会话列表中已有的{skipped, plural, one {# 个会话} other {# 个会话}}。

original: That folder is a protected location ({denied}) and can’t be used here. Choose a different folder.
translation: 该文件夹位于受保护的位置（{denied}），无法在这里使用。请选择其他文件夹。

original: {others, plural, one {# folder was skipped because it’s in a protected location.} other {# folders were skipped because they’re in a protected location.}}
translation: {others, plural, one {# 个文件夹位于受保护的位置，已跳过。} other {# 个文件夹位于受保护的位置，已跳过。}}

original: Claude is working in {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}. Quitting now will interrupt that work.
translation: Claude 正在{count, plural, one {# 个会话} other {# 个会话}}中工作。现在退出会中断这些工作。

original: Your AWS SSO session for profile "{profile}" has expired.
translation: 配置 "{profile}" 的 AWS SSO 会话已过期。

original: This link hides its real destination behind text before the “@” — it actually goes to {host}.
translation: 此链接使用“@”前的文字隐藏真实目标，实际上会前往 {host}。

original: No space could be freed. Caches and temporary files are already clean.
translation: 无法释放更多空间。缓存和临时文件已经清理。

original: The extension couldn't be installed due to the following error: {errorMessage}
The host now reports a platform Claude Code can’t run on, so the sessions you left running there can’t reconnect. Check that this SSH host still points at the machine they were started on.
translation: 主机目前报告的平台不支持 Claude Code，因此留在那里的运行中会话无法重新连接。请检查此 SSH 主机是否仍指向会话启动时使用的电脑。

original: Your other devices can't start sessions on this computer until you sign in again.
translation: 重新登录之前，其他设备无法在这台电脑上启动会话。

original: The host’s SSH key has changed, so the connection is being refused. If the host was not rebuilt or re-keyed, do not trust the new key. Once known_hosts has the right key, the sessions you left running there reconnect.
translation: 主机的 SSH 密钥已更改，因此连接被拒绝。如果主机没有重装或更换密钥，请不要信任新密钥。known_hosts 中记录正确密钥后，留在那里的运行中会话会重新连接。

original: Your organization’s policy requires a newer version of Claude. Update to continue using Code.
translation: 组织策略要求使用更新版本的 Claude。请更新后继续使用 Code。

original: Claude Code is running without a folder yet. Click to open it.
translation: Claude Code 正在运行，尚未选择文件夹。点击打开。

original: Enter your key's passphrase in Claude to continue.
translation: 在 Claude 中输入密钥口令以继续。
将版本 {version} 复制到剪贴板

original: Up to {limit} folders on this computer can be listed for your phone and claude.ai. Remove one to make room, then try again.
translation: 最多可列出这台电脑上的 {limit} 个文件夹，供手机和 claude.ai 使用。请移除一个文件夹后重试。

original: The extension couldn't be previewed due to the following error. Please ensure the DXT file is valid and try again. {errorMessage}
translation: 无法预览扩展，错误如下。请确认 DXT 文件有效后重试。{errorMessage}

original: Turn off Remote Control and stop {count, plural, one {# remote session} other {# remote sessions}}?
translation: 关闭远程控制并停止{count, plural, one {# 个远程会话} other {# 个远程会话}}？

original: Your organization doesn't allow Cowork tasks on this computer.
translation: 组织不允许在这台电脑上运行 Cowork 任务。
在 Claude Code 中打开

original: Changes you made may not be saved.
translation: 你所做的更改可能尚未保存。

original: Claude for macOS, Windows, and Linux can connect Claude Cowork and Claude Code to maker devices over BLE, so developers can build hardware that displays permission prompts, recent messages, and other interactions.
translation: macOS、Windows 和 Linux 版 Claude 可通过 BLE 将 Claude Cowork 与 Claude Code 连接到创客设备，让开发者制作显示权限提示、最近消息及其他交互的硬件。

original: Always list “{name}” for your phone and claude.ai?
translation: 始终为手机和 claude.ai 列出“{name}”？

original: Could not verify extension install permissions. Check that you are connected to the internet.
translation: 无法验证扩展安装权限。请检查网络连接。

original: Your Google Cloud credentials were rejected. Refresh your application-default credentials and try again.
translation: Google Cloud 凭据被拒绝。请刷新应用默认凭据后重试。

original: Return to Claude to keep your task moving
translation: 返回 Claude 以继续推进任务

original: Claude removes the folder in ~/.claude/remote/srv that’s in the way, then sets up Claude Code again.
translation: Claude 会删除 ~/.claude/remote/srv 中造成冲突的文件夹，然后重新设置 Claude Code。

original: Ask your administrator to update Claude.

The device tools on this computer changed after Claude last approved them. This usually happens when the SDK is updated. Click Allow to let Claude use the updated tools. If you did not expect this change, click Cancel.
translation: 自 Claude 上次批准以来，这台电脑上的设备工具已更改，通常是由于 SDK 更新。点击“允许”以使用更新后的工具；如果此更改不符合预期，请点击“取消”。

original: This will upload the file to Claude so it can read it. Claude may share its contents with third-party tools it connects to. Be careful about exposing sensitive information.
translation: 这会将文件上传至 Claude，以便读取。Claude 可能将文件内容分享给它连接的第三方工具。请注意避免泄露敏感信息。

original: Do not sign in to real accounts on this device.
translation: 请勿在此设备上登录真实账号。

original: This is Claude’s first connection to this machine. Review its key in Claude to continue.
translation: 这是 Claude 首次连接这台电脑。请在 Claude 中检查其密钥以继续。

original: Add a folder to Remote Control
translation: 将文件夹添加到远程控制

original: While Claude is running, sessions on your phone and claude.ai, including your cloud sessions, can read and edit files and run commands in your trusted folders. Click to choose folders or turn this off.
translation: Claude 运行时，手机和 claude.ai 上的会话（包括云端会话）可以在可信文件夹中读取和编辑文件、运行命令。点击选择文件夹或关闭此功能。

original: Your AWS IAM Identity Center session has expired.
translation: AWS IAM Identity Center 会话已过期。

original: Claude will {reason}. macOS may also ask for your login password to unlock that browser’s saved data.
translation: Claude 将{reason}。macOS 也可能要求输入登录密码，以解锁该浏览器保存的数据。

original: Choose a project folder inside “{root}”, not “{root}” itself.
translation: 请选择“{root}”内的项目文件夹，而不是“{root}”本身。

original: {host} is out of disk space (or your quota there is used up), so the sessions you left running there can’t reconnect until you free some space on it (your home directory or /tmp).
translation: {host} 的磁盘空间不足或配额已用完。请在主目录或 /tmp 中释放空间，留在那里的运行中会话才能重新连接。

original: Error cleaning up Cowork disk space
translation: 清理 Cowork 磁盘空间时出错

original: Sessions started from your phone or claude.ai will stop, including any that start while this is open.
translation: 从手机或 claude.ai 启动的会话将停止，包括此窗口打开期间启动的会话。
允许 Claude 读取 {browser} 中的登录信息？

original: Can’t read this repository’s current Git origin
translation: 无法读取此仓库当前的 Git 源地址

original: list the sites you’re signed into in {browser}, to bring them into Cowork’s browser
translation: 列出你在 {browser} 中已登录的网站，以导入 Cowork 浏览器

original: Open {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in Claude?
translation: 在 Claude 中打开{count, plural, one {# 个文件} other {# 个文件}}？

original: Another app wants to open {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in Claude
translation: 另一个应用想要在 Claude 中打开{count, plural, one {# 个文件} other {# 个文件}}

original: {host} refused the SFTP subsystem Claude uses to copy its files, so the sessions you left running there can’t reconnect until it’s enabled (sshd_config: Subsystem sftp) — ask the host’s administrator if it isn’t yours.
translation: {host} 拒绝了 Claude 复制文件所需的 SFTP 子系统。启用之前，留在那里的运行中会话无法重新连接（sshd_config: Subsystem sftp）。如果主机不归你管理，请联系管理员。

original: All importable Claude Code sessions on this computer, whether started in the Code tab or the terminal, are already in your session list, were previously deleted, or are in folders you haven't trusted in Claude yet.
translation: 这台电脑上可导入的 Claude Code 会话（无论从 Code 标签页还是终端启动），均已在列表中、之前已删除，或位于尚未在 Claude 中信任的文件夹。

original: This key is different from the one saved for {host}. Trust it only if the machine was reinstalled or re-keyed and this fingerprint matches the one on that machine.
translation: 此密钥与为 {host} 保存的密钥不同。只有在电脑重装或更换密钥，且此指纹与该电脑上的指纹一致时，才应信任。

original: Tap to copy as an image.
Start this task in a new session, or do it here?
translation: 在新会话中启动此任务，还是在这里处理？

original: Stop {count, plural, one {# remote session} other {# remote sessions}}?
translation: 停止{count, plural, one {# 个远程会话} other {# 个远程会话}}？

original: Another app wants to open “{fileName}” in Claude
translation: 另一个应用想要在 Claude 中打开“{fileName}”
确认此 Git 源地址？
导入 Claude Code CLI 会话

original: Sign in again to keep Remote Control available
translation: 重新登录以继续使用远程控制

original: Couldn't open that session from Claude Code.
translation: 无法从 Claude Code 打开该会话。

original: Your AWS credentials for profile "{profile}" were rejected. If using SSO, sign in again; otherwise contact your administrator.
translation: 配置 "{profile}" 的 AWS 凭据被拒绝。如果使用 SSO，请重新登录；否则请联系管理员。

original: Show Cowork Session Data in File Explorer
translation: 在文件资源管理器中显示 Cowork 会话数据

original: Add this folder to Remote Control?
translation: 将此文件夹添加到远程控制？

original: Claude doesn't have permission to use virtualization (/dev/kvm). Add your user to the 'kvm' group, then log out and back in.
translation: Claude 无权使用虚拟化（/dev/kvm）。请将用户加入 'kvm' 组，然后注销并重新登录。

original: Your sign-in won't be saved on this device. Install and unlock a system keyring (such as {keyringName}), then restart the app.
translation: 登录信息不会保存在此设备上。请安装并解锁系统密钥环（例如 {keyringName}），然后重启应用。
始终允许 Artifact 中的 {protocol} 链接

original: Claude Code is installed on {host} but isn’t responding, so the sessions you left running there can’t reconnect yet. Give the host a minute, then reconnect from the session.
translation: {host} 已安装 Claude Code，但没有响应，因此留在那里的运行中会话暂时无法重新连接。请稍等片刻，再从会话中重新连接。

original: Unpacked or unregistered extensions are disabled by your organization's policy.
translation: 组织策略已禁用未打包或未注册的扩展。

original: Couldn't open that session. Its transcript may have been removed.
translation: 无法打开该会话，其对话记录可能已被移除。

original: Reconnecting to {host} stopped: the ssh program your organization configured can no longer be used on this computer. The sessions you left running there are kept; ask your IT administrator, then reconnect.
translation: 已停止重新连接 {host}：组织配置的 ssh 程序已无法在这台电脑上使用。留在那里的运行中会话已保留；请联系 IT 管理员后重新连接。

original: This will stop any running Cowork tasks, delete the Cowork VM bundle, and restart Claude. The bundle is downloaded again the next time you use Cowork.
translation: 这会停止正在运行的 Cowork 任务、删除 Cowork 虚拟机包并重启 Claude。下次使用 Cowork 时会重新下载虚拟机包。

original: Connections to this host are blocked by your organization’s policy. The sessions you left running there are not affected.
translation: 组织策略禁止连接此主机，留在那里的运行中会话不受影响。

original: This session is in Auto mode, so Claude is using {device} without asking. In other permission modes, Claude asks first.
translation: 此会话处于自动模式，因此 Claude 无需询问即可使用 {device}；在其他权限模式中，Claude 会先询问。

original: While Claude is open, sessions on your other devices can read and edit files and run commands in the folders you trust here, following your approval settings. What they read or run is sent to Anthropic. You can turn this off anytime in Settings.
translation: Claude 打开时，其他设备上的会话可按照你的批准设置，在这里信任的文件夹中读取和编辑文件、运行命令。读取的内容和运行的命令会发送至 Anthropic。你可以随时在设置中关闭。

original: Couldn't open that session. Sign in to the desktop app and try again.
translation: 无法打开该会话。请登录桌面应用后重试。

original: Claude runs in the background even when you close the window. Click the Claude icon in the system tray to reopen the app, or right-click to quit.
translation: 即使关闭窗口，Claude 也会在后台运行。点击系统托盘中的 Claude 图标重新打开应用，或右键点击以退出。

original: Claude crashed repeatedly. Try restarting the app. If it keeps crashing, reinstall Claude from claude.ai/download or choose Help → Troubleshooting → Disable Hardware Acceleration.
translation: Claude 多次崩溃。请尝试重启应用；如果仍然崩溃，请从 claude.ai/download 重新安装，或选择“帮助 → 故障排除 → 关闭硬件加速”。

original: Confirm a machine on the way to {host}
translation: 确认连接 {host} 途中的电脑

original: Cowork requires the vhost_vsock kernel module. Load it with 'sudo modprobe vhost_vsock', then restart Claude.
translation: Cowork 需要 vhost_vsock 内核模块。请使用 'sudo modprobe vhost_vsock' 加载，然后重启 Claude。

original: This artifact wants to open {appName} with the link {url}
translation: 此 Artifact 想要使用链接 {url} 打开 {appName}

original: Signing in to {host} keeps failing. If it uses a password or one-time code, open the session and send a message so you can enter it; otherwise unlock your SSH agent or check your key.
translation: 登录 {host} 持续失败。如果需要密码或一次性验证码，请打开会话并发送消息，以便输入；否则请解锁 SSH agent 或检查密钥。

original: Sessions started from a Claude Code project will pick up where they left off the next time you open Claude.
translation: 从 Claude Code 项目启动的会话，会在下次打开 Claude 时继续之前的工作。

original: Did your browser just confirm that you approved this sign-in?
translation: 浏览器刚刚是否确认你已批准此次登录？

original: Claude will control this emulator and take screenshots of its entire screen.
translation: Claude 将控制此模拟器，并截取整个屏幕。

original: The sign-in gave no address for the account that approved the code, so choose {continueLabel} only if you entered the code yourself and your browser confirmed it. Nothing has been saved yet.
translation: 此次登录没有提供批准验证码的账号地址。因此，只有在你亲自输入验证码且浏览器已确认的情况下，才应选择{continueLabel}。目前尚未保存任何内容。

original: Clear cached web content and restart Claude?
translation: 清除网页缓存并重启 Claude？

original: The skill file couldn't be found.
The access dialog for {device} was not answered; ask again when you're ready.
translation: {device} 的访问对话框未得到回应；准备好后请重新请求。

original: Your organization restricts which folders sessions may use, so session worktrees stay inside the project.
translation: 组织限制了会话可使用的文件夹，因此会话的 Git 工作树会保留在项目内。
重新打开已关闭的会话

original: Claude pinned this origin on its own, reading it from the repository’s config when the folder was trusted or a worktree was made. Confirm only if this is where the repository really lives. Afterwards, Claude merges protected files (.claude, .mcp.json and similar) into your Code sessions from its default branch.
translation: Claude 在文件夹受信任或创建 Git 工作树时，从仓库配置中读取并自动固定了此源地址。只有确认这是仓库的真实位置后，才应继续。随后，Claude 会从其默认分支将受保护文件（.claude、.mcp.json 等）合并到 Code 会话中。

original: Claude will control this simulator and take screenshots of its entire screen.
translation: Claude 将控制此模拟器，并截取整个屏幕。

original: Reconnecting to {host} reaches a machine whose key you haven’t confirmed yet. Open the session and send a message to review the key; once you trust it, the sessions you left running there reconnect.
translation: 重新连接 {host} 时遇到了尚未确认密钥的电脑。请打开会话并发送消息以检查密钥；信任后，留在那里的运行中会话会重新连接。

original: {failed, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} couldn't be imported. Check the logs for details.
translation: {failed, plural, one {# 个会话} other {# 个会话}}无法导入。请查看日志了解详情。

original: This computer is now available from your other devices
translation: 现在可以从其他设备访问这台电脑

original: Claude tried to start several times without success. If Claude still won’t start, choose Help → Get Support and mention error code {exitCode}.
translation: Claude 多次尝试启动但未成功。如果仍无法启动，请选择“帮助 → 获取支持”，并说明错误代码 {exitCode}。

original: Some MCP servers couldn't be loaded
translation: 部分 MCP 服务器无法加载

original: Cowork isn't available on this device: the operating system's kernel doesn't include the virtualization support Cowork needs, and it can't be added manually. This is common on ChromeOS and other container-based Linux environments.
translation: 此设备无法使用 Cowork：操作系统内核缺少 Cowork 所需的虚拟化支持，且无法手动添加。ChromeOS 及其他基于容器的 Linux 环境常见此问题。

original: Your network redirected this request to {host}. Contact your IT administrator.
translation: 网络将此请求重定向到了 {host}。请联系 IT 管理员。

original: Imported {recovered, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}.
translation: 已导入{recovered, plural, one {# 个会话} other {# 个会话}}。

original: This computer is out of disk space, so Claude can’t prepare the files it needs to reconnect to {host}. Free some space here, then reconnect from the session.
translation: 这台电脑的磁盘空间不足，Claude 无法准备重新连接 {host} 所需的文件。请释放空间，再从会话中重新连接。
重新批准 Claude 的设备工具？

original: Reconnecting to {host} stopped: the ssh now on this computer is older than OpenSSH 7.6, which Claude needs. The sessions you left running there are kept; update ssh and they reconnect.
translation: 已停止重新连接 {host}：这台电脑上的 ssh 低于 Claude 所需的 OpenSSH 7.6。留在那里的运行中会话已保留；更新 ssh 后会重新连接。

original: Enter this code on the GitHub page
translation: 在 GitHub 页面输入此验证码

original: Delete Cowork VM sessions and restart?
translation: 删除 Cowork 虚拟机会话并重启？

original: Worktrees that Claude Code created can’t be added on their own. Add the repository they belong to instead.
translation: 无法单独添加 Claude Code 创建的 Git 工作树。请添加它所属的仓库。
没有可导入的 CLI 会话

original: Claude ran into repeated problems with graphics acceleration, so it has been turned off. Restart Claude to apply the change. You can re-enable it anytime from the Help menu.
translation: Claude 多次出现图形加速问题，因此已关闭硬件加速。重启 Claude 以应用更改。你可以随时在帮助菜单中重新启用。

original: This will stop any running Cowork tasks, delete all Cowork session data on this computer, and restart Claude. This can’t be undone.
translation: 这会停止正在运行的 Cowork 任务、删除这台电脑上的全部 Cowork 会话数据并重启 Claude。此操作无法撤销。

original: There’s an error in your SSH configuration. Your sessions on {host} are kept and reconnect once you fix it.
translation: SSH 配置存在错误。{host} 上的会话已保留，修复后会重新连接。

original: Choose {cancelLabel} unless this is your account and your browser just confirmed that you approved the sign-in. Nothing has been saved yet.
translation: 除非这是你的账号，且浏览器刚刚确认你已批准登录，否则请选择{cancelLabel}。目前尚未保存任何内容。

original: Remove “{folderName}” and stop {count, plural, one {# remote session} other {# remote sessions}}?
translation: 移除“{folderName}”并停止{count, plural, one {# 个远程会话} other {# 个远程会话}}？

original: macOS won’t let the ssh you installed reach your local network when Claude runs it, and the Mac’s built-in ssh couldn’t connect to {host} either. Your sessions there are kept. Open one to see what to fix; they reconnect once you do.
translation: Claude 运行你安装的 ssh 时，macOS 不允许它访问本地网络；Mac 内置的 ssh 也无法连接到 {host}。那里的会话已保留。打开一个会话查看需要修复的问题，修复后会自动重新连接。

original: This removes caches and temporary files from Cowork sessions that aren't currently running. Files in session workspaces are not affected.
translation: 这会删除当前未运行的 Cowork 会话的缓存和临时文件，不会影响会话工作区中的文件。

original: {skipped, plural, one {# selected folder was skipped.} other {# selected folders were skipped.}}
translation: {skipped, plural, one {已跳过 # 个选中的文件夹。} other {已跳过 # 个选中的文件夹。}}
选择 Claude 数据文件夹

original: Enter your password or verification code in Claude to continue.
translation: 在 Claude 中输入密码或验证码以继续。

original: The configured API key was rejected by the inference provider. Contact your administrator — it may have been rotated or revoked.
translation: 推理服务提供方拒绝了配置的 API 密钥。请联系管理员，密钥可能已轮换或撤销。

original: Claude can read and edit files and run commands in this folder. To stop, disconnect in the session or turn off Remote Control.
translation: Claude 可以在此文件夹中读取和编辑文件、运行命令。如需停止，请在会话中断开连接或关闭远程控制。

original: The Chrome extension's session expired. Open the Claude extension in Chrome and sign in again, then retry.
translation: Chrome 扩展的会话已过期。请在 Chrome 中打开 Claude 扩展，重新登录后重试。

original: Go back to Claude to finish setting up the iOS Simulator.
translation: 返回 Claude，完成 iOS 模拟器的设置。

original: Cowork requires QEMU. Install it with ''{installCommand}'', then restart Claude.
translation: Cowork 需要 QEMU。请使用 ''{installCommand}'' 安装，然后重启 Claude。

original: Couldn’t check this Mac for organization settings
translation: 无法检查这台 Mac 的组织设置

original: This version of Cowork doesn't support disk cleanup yet. Restart the app and try again.
translation: 此版本的 Cowork 尚不支持磁盘清理。请重启应用后重试。

original: Claude couldn't be moved to the Applications folder. You can keep using it from here, or drag it to Applications yourself from Finder.
translation: 无法将 Claude 移至 Applications 文件夹。你可以继续从当前位置使用，也可以在 Finder 中手动将其拖至 Applications。

original: Claude needs your input to continue
translation: Claude 需要你的输入才能继续

original: Claude crashed repeatedly. Try restarting the app. If it keeps crashing, reinstall Claude from the Microsoft Store or from your organization's app catalog.
translation: Claude 多次崩溃。请尝试重启应用；如果仍然崩溃，请从 Microsoft Store 或组织的应用目录重新安装 Claude。

original: The credential helper's token was rejected by the inference provider. It may need to re-authenticate.
translation: 推理服务提供方拒绝了凭据助手的令牌，可能需要重新认证。

original: Use this computer from your phone and claude.ai?
translation: 允许从手机和 claude.ai 使用这台电脑？

original: The extension couldn't be installed. Please ensure the extension folder is valid and try again. The error was: {errorMessage}
translation: 无法安装扩展。请确认扩展文件夹有效后重试。错误：{errorMessage}

original: Could not verify extension with allowlist service
translation: 无法通过允许列表服务验证扩展

original: Claude needs to fix file ownership so auto-updates can work correctly.
translation: Claude 需要修复文件所有权，才能正常自动更新。

original: This will open {appName} with the phone number {number}.
translation: 这会使用电话号码 {number} 打开 {appName}。

original: Access denied by your organization. Contact your administrator.
translation: 组织拒绝了访问。请联系管理员。
用量图片已复制到剪贴板

original: This will open your default calling or messaging application with the phone number {number}.
translation: 这会使用电话号码 {number} 打开默认的通话或消息应用。

original: This will upload these files to Claude so it can read them. Claude may share their contents with third-party tools it connects to. Be careful about exposing sensitive information.
translation: 这会将这些文件上传至 Claude，以便读取。Claude 可能将文件内容分享给它连接的第三方工具。请注意避免泄露敏感信息。

original: Claude pins each repository's Git origin the first time it works there, and merges protected files into Code sessions only from that origin's default branch. Every pinned origin still matches its repository.
translation: Claude 首次处理仓库时会固定其 Git 源地址，并且只从该源的默认分支将受保护文件合并到 Code 会话中。目前所有固定的源地址仍与对应仓库一致。

original: Pinned folders stay listed even when you use other folders more. You can unpin it anytime in Settings.
translation: 即使你更常使用其他文件夹，固定的文件夹也会保留在列表中。你可以随时在设置中取消固定。
在此新建 Claude Code 会话

original: Cowork requires hardware virtualization (KVM), which isn't available on this device. Enable virtualization in your firmware settings to use this feature.
translation: Cowork 需要硬件虚拟化（KVM），此设备目前不可用。请在固件设置中启用虚拟化以使用此功能。

original: Your home directory on {host} is read-only, so the sessions you left running there can’t reconnect until its disk is fixed.
translation: {host} 上的主目录为只读。修复其磁盘之前，留在那里的运行中会话无法重新连接。

original: This stops every running WSL distribution and the sessions and apps in them.
translation: 这会停止所有正在运行的 WSL 发行版，以及其中的会话和应用。
重新固定此 Git 源地址？

original: {action, select, connect {Connect connector} disconnect {Disconnect connector} apply {Review configuration} other {Confirm}}
translation: {action, select, connect {连接连接器} disconnect {断开连接器} apply {检查配置} other {确认}}

original: starting without a folder isn't available
translation: 暂不支持不选择文件夹直接启动

original: All {limit} folders that can be listed are already pinned. Unpin or remove one, then try again.
translation: 列表支持的 {limit} 个文件夹均已固定。请取消固定或移除一个文件夹后重试。

original: This folder can’t be added right now. Try again in a moment.
translation: 目前无法添加此文件夹。请稍后重试。
无法打开指定的文件夹。
已达到文件夹数量上限

original: To stay within the folder limit, “{name}” will no longer be listed.
translation: 为满足文件夹数量限制，“{name}”将不再显示在列表中。

original: Your AWS credentials for profile "{profile}" were rejected. Refresh the credentials for that profile and try again.
translation: 配置 "{profile}" 的 AWS 凭据被拒绝。请刷新该配置的凭据后重试。

original: In bypass permissions mode, Claude skips permission checks and takes actions and runs commands without asking for approval. This includes risky actions and actions that may result in prompt injections. This mode should only be used in isolated environments.
translation: 在跳过权限检查模式下，Claude 会跳过权限检查，不经确认就执行操作和命令，包括高风险操作及可能导致提示词注入的操作。此模式仅应在隔离环境中使用。

original: That location isn’t a folder. Choose a folder.
translation: 该位置不是文件夹。请选择文件夹。

original: You stay signed in. Open conversations and tasks are kept; the app closes and reopens.
translation: 你会保持登录，对话和任务也会保留；应用将关闭并重新打开。

original: You signed in to a different organization than the one that manages this desktop. Sign in again and choose that organization.
translation: 你登录的组织与管理此桌面的组织不同。请重新登录并选择正确的组织。
新建 Claude Code 会话

original: Pinned Git origins are up to date
translation: 固定的 Git 源地址均为最新

original: The folder you choose is trusted for Claude Code and can be opened from your phone or claude.ai.
translation: 所选文件夹将被 Claude Code 信任，并可从手机或 claude.ai 打开。

original: Don’t ask again for links to {host}
translation: 对指向 {host} 的链接不再询问

original: Claude crashed because of repeated graphics problems in the previous session, so hardware acceleration has been turned off. You can re-enable it anytime from the Help menu.
translation: 上次会话中反复出现图形问题，导致 Claude 崩溃，因此已关闭硬件加速。你可以随时在帮助菜单中重新启用。

original: Opus consumes usage limits faster than other models
translation: Opus 比其他模型更快消耗使用限额

original: Best for math and coding challenges
Claude uses its access to the web to improve answers when appropriate.
translation: 在适当情况下，Claude 会利用网络访问改善回答。
处理复杂任务时进行思考

original: Upload CSVs for Claude to analyze quantitative data with high accuracy and create interactive data visualizations.
translation: 上传 CSV 文件，让 Claude 准确分析定量数据，并创建交互式数据可视化。

original: For complex work and everyday tasks
translation: 适合复杂工作和日常任务
适合最具挑战性的任务
根据复杂程度调整思考

original: Can think for more complex tasks
translation: 可以为复杂任务进行思考

original: Claude can search the internet to provide more up-to-date and relevant responses. Claude will automatically determine when to use web search if the topic requires current information. Web search is only available when using Claude 3.7 Sonnet.
translation: Claude 可以搜索网络，提供更新、更相关的回答。话题需要最新信息时，Claude 会自动判断是否使用网络搜索。网络搜索仅适用于 Claude 3.7 Sonnet。

original: Claude can write and run code to process data, run analysis, and produce data visualizations in real time.
translation: Claude 可以编写并运行代码，实时处理数据、开展分析并生成数据可视化。

original: This artifact belongs to a different organization
translation: 此 Artifact 属于另一个组织

original: Only people who can edit this artifact can start a task from it
translation: 只有可编辑此 Artifact 的用户才能从中启动任务

original: Claude can’t start a task for this artifact here
translation: Claude 无法在这里为此 Artifact 启动任务

original: This artifact is no longer available to you
Start the chat from the artifact
This artifact belongs to a different organization. Switch organizations to work on it with Claude.
translation: 此 Artifact 属于另一个组织。请切换组织后使用 Claude 处理。

original: Couldn’t reach this artifact. You can try again.
translation: 无法访问此 Artifact，请重试。

original: To work on this artifact with Claude, open it and choose “Start one now” under Send to Claude.
translation: 如需使用 Claude 处理此 Artifact，请打开它，并在“发送至 Claude”下选择“立即开始”。

original: Switch organizations to work on it with Claude.
translation: 切换组织后使用 Claude 处理。

original: You can still open the conversation you were sent to.
translation: 你仍然可以打开此前跳转到的对话。

original: Your comment may already be in the conversation it was sent to.
translation: 评论可能已存在于它被发送到的对话中。

original: Open the artifact and choose “Start one now” under Send to Claude.
translation: 打开 Artifact，并在“发送至 Claude”下选择“立即开始”。

original: Your comment is already in the conversation
{connectorName} is on for this chat so Claude can reply in your document.
translation: 此对话已启用 {connectorName}，Claude 可以在文档中回复。

original: Start a task about this artifact?
translation: 为此 Artifact 启动任务？

original: Claude will open “{title}” in a new Cowork task so you can ask for changes.
translation: Claude 会在新的 Cowork 任务中打开“{title}”，以便你提出修改要求。

original: Claude will open the artifact in a new Cowork task so you can ask for changes.
translation: Claude 会在新的 Cowork 任务中打开此 Artifact，以便你提出修改要求。
指向 claude.ai/mobile 的二维码

original: Your recent sessions. Sessions on this computer appear on your phone once you set up Remote Control.
translation: 你的最近会话。设置远程控制后，这台电脑上的会话会显示在手机上。

original: Your recent sessions, as they appear on your phone.
translation: 你的最近会话，显示效果与手机上一致。

original: Your sessions keep running.{br}Take them with you.
translation: 会话会继续运行。{br}随时随地继续处理。

original: The sessions in this sidebar also show up in the Claude app on your phone, so you can keep work moving while you’re away from your computer.
translation: 侧边栏中的会话也会显示在手机的 Claude 应用中，离开电脑后仍可继续工作。
在 Claude 需要你时回复

original: Get a notification when Claude asks for permission or has a question. Allow, deny, or reply from your phone.
translation: Claude 请求权限或提出问题时会通知你。你可以从手机允许、拒绝或回复。

original: Pick a repository and describe the task. Claude works on it in the cloud, and the session is here when you’re back.
translation: 选择仓库并描述任务。Claude 会在云端处理，回到电脑后即可继续会话。

original: Set up <link>Remote Control</link> to continue sessions running on this computer from your phone.
translation: 设置<link>远程控制</link>，即可从手机继续这台电脑上正在运行的会话。

original: Read changes file by file, leave comments, and merge when checks pass.
translation: 逐个文件查看更改、留下评论，并在检查通过后合并。

original: Scan with your phone to get the Claude app
translation: 用手机扫码获取 Claude 应用

original: Routine “{name}” was skipped. Couldn’t check whether this workspace is trusted. Try again.
translation: 已跳过例行任务“{name}”，无法确认此工作区是否受信任。请重试。

original: Routine couldn’t be started. You can try again.
translation: 无法启动例行任务，请重试。

original: Running routines isn’t available. Update the Claude desktop app and try again.
translation: 目前无法运行例行任务。请更新 Claude 桌面应用后重试。

original: Schedule couldn’t be enabled. You can try again.
Schedule couldn’t be paused. You can try again.
Tool approval couldn’t be removed. You can try again.
translation: 无法移除工具授权，请重试。

original: Artifacts are turned off for your organization
Artifacts are disabled by your organization’s policy. Contact your organization admin to enable them.
translation: 组织策略已禁用 Artifacts。请联系组织管理员以启用。

original: Your organization admin hasn’t given you access to Artifacts. Contact your admin to request access.
translation: 组织管理员尚未授予你 Artifacts 访问权限。请联系管理员申请。

original: Artifacts aren’t included in your organization’s plan.
Artifacts are disabled by your organization’s policy.
{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} {action, select, archive {archived} unarchive {unarchived} delete {deleted} other {}}
translation: {count, plural, one {# 个项目} other {# 个项目}}{action, select, archive {已归档} unarchive {已取消归档} delete {已删除} other {}}

original: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} could not be {action, select, archive {archived} unarchive {unarchived} delete {deleted} other {}}.
translation: {count, plural, one {# 个项目} other {# 个项目}}无法{action, select, archive {归档} unarchive {取消归档} delete {删除} other {处理}}。

original: Deleting {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}…
translation: 正在删除{count, plural, one {# 个项目} other {# 个项目}}…

original: Links you share will show up here.
translation: 你分享的链接会显示在这里。

original: Archived sessions will show up here.
translation: 已归档的会话会显示在这里。

original: Sessions you start will show up here.
translation: 你启动的会话会显示在这里。

original: Sessions you start will show up here
translation: 你创建的会话会显示在这里

original: {kind, select, tasks {Search tasks...} chats {Search chats...} other {Search chats and tasks...}}
translation: {kind, select, tasks {搜索任务…} chats {搜索对话…} other {搜索对话和任务…}}
排序也适用于搜索结果
搜索范围为显示的标题。

original: {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}} will be moved to Archived.
translation: {count, plural, one {# 个任务} other {# 个任务}}将移至已归档。

original: {count, plural, one {# selected task} other {# selected tasks}} can’t be deleted and will be skipped.
translation: {count, plural, one {# 个选中的任务} other {# 个选中的任务}}无法删除，将予以跳过。

original: Waiting for {host}: it isn’t reachable from this network.
translation: 等待 {host}：当前网络无法访问。

original: Waiting for {host}: its name doesn’t resolve.
Waiting for {host}: it refused the connection.
Waiting for {host}: its proxy command couldn’t get through.
translation: 等待 {host}：代理命令无法建立连接。

original: Waiting for {host}: it is slow to answer.
Waiting for {host}: setting up Claude Code on it failed.
translation: 等待 {host}：设置 Claude Code 失败。
等待 {host} 恢复可访问状态。

original: {host} is stopped; Retry now starts it and sends your message.
translation: {host} 已停止；立即重试会启动主机并发送消息。

original: {host} is connected, but Claude Code didn’t start there. Your message is still waiting.
translation: 已连接 {host}，但 Claude Code 未能启动。消息仍在等待发送。

original: Waiting for you: sign in to Claude again to send your message to {host}.
translation: 等待你处理：请重新登录 Claude，以向 {host} 发送消息。

original: Waiting for you: {host} needs you to confirm it’s you (security key or browser sign-in).
translation: 等待你处理：{host} 需要验证你的身份（安全密钥或浏览器登录）。

original: Waiting for you: {host} needs you to sign in before this can be sent. Claude will ask as soon as you’re back.
translation: 等待你处理：发送前需要登录 {host}。你返回后，Claude 会立即询问。

original: Waiting for you: {host} wouldn’t take a key from this computer yet (is your SSH agent locked?). Claude will try again as soon as that changes or you’re back.
translation: 等待你处理：{host} 尚未接受这台电脑的密钥（SSH agent 是否已锁定？）。状态改变或你返回后，Claude 会立即重试。

original: Will retry when you’re back online.
{host} needs you to sign in before your message can go.
{host} didn’t accept your SSH key. Unlock your agent, then retry.
translation: {host} 未接受 SSH 密钥。请解锁 SSH agent 后重试。

original: No SSH key was available for {host}. Start or unlock your agent and load your key; your message goes as soon as Claude sees one appear, or retry now.
translation: 没有可用于 {host} 的 SSH 密钥。请启动或解锁 SSH agent 并加载密钥；Claude 检测到密钥后会发送消息，也可立即重试。

original: Your SSH agent wouldn’t use its key for {host} (locked, or an approval it asked for wasn’t given). Unlock it, or approve when it asks, then retry. Your message also goes by itself if Claude sees the agent’s keys change.
translation: SSH agent 无法为 {host} 使用密钥，可能已锁定或其请求未获批准。请解锁或批准请求后重试。Claude 检测到 SSH agent 的密钥变化后，也会自动发送消息。

original: {host} accepted your SSH key, but this computer couldn’t sign with it. Retry to enter the key’s passphrase.
translation: {host} 已接受 SSH 密钥，但这台电脑无法使用它签名。请重试并输入密钥口令。

original: None of your agent’s keys were offered to {host}. Set SSH key in this host’s settings, then retry.
translation: SSH agent 中的密钥均未提供给 {host}。请在主机设置中配置 SSH 密钥后重试。

original: {host} closed the sign-in after too many keys. Set SSH key in this host’s settings, then retry.
translation: 尝试的密钥过多，{host} 已关闭登录。请在主机设置中配置 SSH 密钥后重试。

original: Your SSH key’s signature type can’t be used with {host}. Use a key type both sides allow (usually ed25519), then retry.
translation: SSH 密钥的签名类型无法用于 {host}。请使用双方均允许的密钥类型（通常为 ed25519）后重试。

original: {host} doesn’t accept RSA keys. Use a key of a type it accepts (usually ed25519), then retry.
translation: {host} 不接受 RSA 密钥。请使用主机接受的密钥类型（通常为 ed25519）后重试。

original: {host} needs you to sign in. Unlock your SSH agent or have your password ready.
translation: 需要登录 {host}。请解锁 SSH agent 或准备密码。

original: Your SSH key file for {host} can’t be used. Check the file under SSH key, then retry. You’ll be asked for its passphrase if it has one.
translation: 无法使用 {host} 的 SSH 密钥文件。请检查“SSH 密钥”中的文件后重试。如果密钥设有口令，会要求输入。

original: The SSH key file set for {host} wasn’t found on this computer. Fix the path under SSH key, then retry.
translation: 这台电脑上找不到为 {host} 设置的 SSH 密钥文件。请修正“SSH 密钥”中的路径后重试。

original: Your key file for {host} can be read by other accounts, so ssh won’t use it. Run chmod 600 on it, then retry.
translation: 其他账号可以读取 {host} 的密钥文件，因此 ssh 拒绝使用。请对其运行 chmod 600 后重试。

original: {host} needs your private key: a .pub is set and your agent didn’t supply the key. Unlock your agent or set the private key file, then retry.
translation: {host} 需要私钥：当前设置的是 .pub 文件，SSH agent 也未提供私钥。请解锁 SSH agent 或设置私钥文件后重试。

original: The key file for {host} is a PuTTY .ppk that couldn’t be used. Export it as an OpenSSH key, then retry.
translation: {host} 的密钥文件为无法使用的 PuTTY .ppk 文件。请导出为 OpenSSH 密钥后重试。

original: The SSH key set for {host} isn’t a private key file. Choose your private key file, then retry.
translation: 为 {host} 设置的 SSH 密钥不是私钥文件。请选择私钥文件后重试。

original: Your key file for {host} couldn’t be parsed. Replace it with a fresh copy of the key, then retry.
translation: 无法解析 {host} 的密钥文件。请用新的密钥副本替换后重试。

original: macOS blocked ssh from reading your key file for {host}. Allow Claude access under System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders (or move the key into ~/.ssh), then retry.
translation: macOS 阻止 ssh 读取 {host} 的密钥文件。请在“系统设置 › 隐私与安全 › 文件与文件夹”中允许 Claude 访问，或将密钥移至 ~/.ssh，然后重试。

original: Your ssh can’t read the key for {host} where it’s kept — move it into ~/.ssh and update the key path, then retry.
translation: ssh 无法从当前存放位置读取 {host} 的密钥。请将其移至 ~/.ssh 并更新密钥路径后重试。

original: {host} needs your key’s passphrase before your message can go. Retry and enter it.
translation: 发送消息前，{host} 需要密钥口令。请重试并输入。

original: {host}’s host key changed. Don’t trust the new key unless the machine was reinstalled or re-keyed. If it was, update known_hosts and retry.
translation: {host} 的主机密钥已更改。除非电脑已重装或更换密钥，否则不要信任新密钥。如果确实已更改，请更新 known_hosts 后重试。

original: {host} presents a different host key than the one Claude recorded on its first connection. Don’t trust the new key unless the machine was reinstalled or re-keyed. If it was, connect once with ssh in a terminal to accept it, then retry.
translation: {host} 提供的主机密钥与 Claude 首次连接时记录的不同。除非电脑已重装或更换密钥，否则不要信任。如果确实已更改，请先在终端用 ssh 连接一次以接受新密钥，然后重试。

original: Connecting to {host} reaches a machine Claude hasn’t seen before. Confirm its key and your message goes.
translation: 连接 {host} 时遇到了 Claude 未连接过的电脑。确认其密钥后会发送消息。

original: You didn’t trust a key presented while connecting to {host}, so your message is held. Review the key again to connect.
translation: 你未信任连接 {host} 时提供的密钥，因此消息已暂存。请重新检查密钥以连接。

original: {host} asked for a password or one-time code, which can’t be prompted for with its current SSH setup, and no SSH key was accepted instead. Load your key into the agent, or test the connection in this host’s settings to see what to change, then retry.
translation: {host} 请求密码或一次性验证码，但当前 SSH 设置无法显示输入提示，也没有接受 SSH 密钥。请将密钥加载至 SSH agent，或在主机设置中测试连接以检查需要修改的设置，然后重试。

original: Connecting to {host} is blocked by your organization’s settings.
{host} no longer reports a system Claude Code runs on. Check that it’s still the same machine.
translation: {host} 目前报告的系统不支持 Claude Code。请确认仍是同一台电脑。

original: {host} has SFTP turned off, so Claude can’t copy its files. Enable Subsystem sftp on the host, then retry.
translation: {host} 已关闭 SFTP，Claude 无法复制文件。请在主机上启用 Subsystem sftp 后重试。

original: {host} is out of disk space. Free some space there (home directory or /tmp), then retry.
translation: {host} 磁盘空间不足。请在主目录或 /tmp 中释放空间后重试。

original: {host}’s disk is read-only. Fix the disk there, then retry.
translation: {host} 的磁盘为只读。请修复后重试。

original: Claude Code is installed on {host} but isn’t responding. Give the host a minute, then retry.
translation: {host} 已安装 Claude Code，但没有响应。请稍等片刻后重试。

original: This computer is out of disk space. Free some space here, then retry.
translation: 这台电脑的磁盘空间不足。请释放空间后重试。

original: {host}’s SSH server isn’t compatible with this client.
translation: {host} 的 SSH 服务器与此客户端不兼容。

original: {host}’s proxy command can’t get through. Act on what it reported, then retry.
translation: {host} 的代理命令无法建立连接。请根据其输出处理后重试。

original: {host} is stopped; start it to send your message.
translation: {host} 已停止；请启动后发送消息。

original: Couldn’t set up Claude Code on {host}. Check it has disk space and can run the installer, then retry.
translation: 无法在 {host} 上设置 Claude Code。请检查磁盘空间以及能否运行安装器后重试。

original: Can’t reach {host}. Redialing stopped after repeated failures.
translation: 无法访问 {host}。多次失败后已停止重连。

original: Your ssh stops at an error in your SSH configuration, so {host} can’t be reached. Fix it, then retry.
translation: SSH 配置错误导致 ssh 停止，无法访问 {host}。请修复后重试。

original: This computer’s ssh is older than OpenSSH 7.6, which Claude needs to reach {host}. Update it, then retry.
translation: 这台电脑上的 ssh 低于连接 {host} 所需的 OpenSSH 7.6。请更新后重试。

original: macOS won’t let the ssh you installed reach your local network when Claude runs it, and the Mac’s built-in ssh couldn’t connect to {host} either. Test the connection in this host’s settings to see what to fix, then retry.
translation: Claude 运行你安装的 ssh 时，macOS 不允许它访问本地网络；Mac 内置的 ssh 也无法连接 {host}。请在主机设置中测试连接，检查并修复后重试。

original: The ssh program your organization configured can’t be used on this computer, so {host} can’t be reached. Ask your IT administrator, then retry.
translation: 组织配置的 ssh 程序无法在这台电脑上使用，因此无法访问 {host}。请联系 IT 管理员后重试。

original: Last output before the connection closed: “{line}”
translation: 连接关闭前的最后输出：“{line}”

original: Enter only user@hostname here. Options such as the port or key go in the fields below or in ~/.ssh/config.
translation: 这里只需输入 user@hostname。端口、密钥等选项请填写在下方字段或 ~/.ssh/config 中。

original: Remove the ssh:// prefix and enter user@hostname.
translation: 移除 ssh:// 前缀并输入 user@hostname。

original: If the part after the colon is a port, put it in the SSH port field instead. A host alias from ~/.ssh/config that contains a colon is fine as it is.
translation: 如果冒号后的部分是端口，请改为填写在“SSH 端口”字段中。~/.ssh/config 中含冒号的主机别名可以保持原样。

original: This is not a valid host name or address. Use letters, digits, ‘.’, ‘-’, ‘_’ or ‘:’ and do not start with ‘-’.
translation: 主机名或地址无效。请使用字母、数字、‘.’、‘-’、‘_’或‘:’，且不能以‘-’开头。

original: The part before @ is not a valid username. Use letters, digits, ‘.’, ‘-’, ‘_’ or ‘\’ and do not start with ‘-’.
translation: @ 前的用户名无效。请使用字母、数字、‘.’、‘-’、‘_’或‘\’，且不能以‘-’开头。

original: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
translation: 端口必须是 1 至 65535 之间的数字。

original: This connects to this computer over SSH. To work in a folder on this computer, choose the Local environment instead.
translation: 这会通过 SSH 连接这台电脑。如需在本机文件夹中工作，请选择本地环境。

original: Use an absolute path (/…) or one in your home directory (~/…).
translation: 请使用绝对路径（/…）或主目录中的路径（~/…）。

original: The path can’t contain “.” or “..” segments.
Use a POSIX path (/… or ~/…); Windows hosts aren’t supported yet.
translation: 请使用 POSIX 路径（/… 或 ~/…）；暂不支持 Windows 主机。

original: The path contains control or invisible formatting characters.
translation: 路径包含控制字符或不可见的格式字符。

original: Choose a directory, not the filesystem root.
translation: 请选择文件夹，而不是文件系统根目录。

original: For this host only, on this computer.
translation: 仅适用于这台电脑上的此主机。

original: Leave empty to use {folder}, this host’s default from its ~/.claude/settings.json.
translation: 留空以使用 {folder}，这是主机 ~/.claude/settings.json 中的默认值。

original: Leave empty to keep each session’s worktree inside its project (.claude/worktrees).
translation: 留空以将每个会话的 Git 工作树保留在对应项目中（.claude/worktrees）。

original: Leave empty to use the host’s default: the folder its ~/.claude/settings.json sets, if any, otherwise inside each project.
translation: 留空以使用主机默认值：优先使用 ~/.claude/settings.json 中指定的文件夹，否则保留在各项目中。

original: Folder on this host where new sessions create their Git worktrees, one subfolder per project. Start with ~/ for your home directory there.
translation: 新会话在此主机上创建 Git 工作树的位置，每个项目使用一个子文件夹。以 ~/ 开头可使用该主机的主目录。

original: That worktree folder is not valid.
translation: Git 工作树文件夹无效。
Git 工作树文件夹已保存。

original: Couldn’t save the worktree folder. You can try again.
translation: 无法保存 Git 工作树文件夹，请重试。

original: Couldn’t save the SSH connection. You can try again.
translation: 无法保存 SSH 连接，请重试。

original: Output captured during the connection attempt (from your proxy command, ssh, or the remote host)
translation: 连接尝试期间捕获的输出（来自代理命令、ssh 或远程主机）
密码已于 {date} 保存 · <forget>忘记</forget>

original: {count, plural, one {# connector tool} other {# connector tools}} always allowed · <forget>Forget</forget>
translation: 始终允许{count, plural, one {# 个连接器工具} other {# 个连接器工具}} · <forget>忘记</forget>

original: This test used the key from Claude’s existing connection to this host, not what’s set under SSH key. Once you save, Claude uses that setting the next time it connects. If another test of this host is still finishing, test again in a moment.
translation: 此测试使用了 Claude 与此主机的现有连接中的密钥，而非“SSH 密钥”中的设置。保存后，下次连接会使用新设置。如果此主机的另一项测试仍在结束中，请稍后再次测试。

original: You’re about to connect to a remote host via SSH. Claude will be able to read and modify files on this server.
translation: 即将通过 SSH 连接远程主机。Claude 将能够读取和修改该服务器上的文件。

original: This host and folder came from a link you opened.
translation: 此主机和文件夹来自你打开的链接。

original: This host came from a link you opened.
translation: 此主机来自你打开的链接。

original: “{connectionName}” will be permanently deleted. This can’t be undone.
translation: 将永久删除“{connectionName}”，此操作无法撤销。

original: Connected. This host is ready to use.
You already have an SSH connection for this host: {name}.
translation: 此主机已有 SSH 连接：{name}。

original: A friendly name for this SSH connection.
translation: 此 SSH 连接的显示名称。

original: Leave empty to use default (22) or your SSH configuration.
translation: 留空以使用默认端口（22）或 SSH 配置。

original: PuTTY key: Claude converts it for OpenSSH and keeps a private copy in its data folder.
translation: PuTTY 密钥：Claude 会将其转换为 OpenSSH 格式，并在数据文件夹中保存私有副本。

original: Path to a private key. Leave empty to use your SSH configuration or agent.
translation: 私钥路径。留空以使用 SSH 配置或 SSH agent。
不使用 Git 工作树

original: Couldn’t switch environments: {what} isn’t available anymore.
translation: 无法切换环境：{what} 已不可用。
无法保存此环境的变量。

original: Couldn’t set up the default cloud environment. Try again.
translation: 无法设置默认云端环境，请重试。

original: Couldn’t load your cloud environments. Try again.
translation: 无法加载云端环境，请重试。

original: Something went wrong loading this session.

translation: 展开或收起 {name} 的详情

original: Auto mode is using Claude Code’s built-in classifier in this session, and those classifier requests are billed. Continue to keep going in auto mode, or Stop to end this turn.
translation: 此会话的自动模式正在使用 Claude Code 内置分类器，分类器请求会计费。选择“继续”以保持自动模式，或选择“停止”以结束本轮。

original: Some files were too large to attach. Maximum size is 30 MB.
translation: 部分文件过大，无法添加为附件。大小上限为 30 MB。

original: Attachments are limited to 50 MB total per message on remote sessions.
translation: 远程会话中，每条消息的附件总大小上限为 50 MB。

original: Maximum of {max} file attachments per message.
translation: 每条消息最多添加 {max} 个文件附件。

original: That session is still open in a terminal. Close it there, then try again.
translation: 该会话仍在终端中打开。请先在终端关闭后重试。

original: That session’s folder isn’t trusted yet. Start a session in that folder first, then try again.
translation: 该会话的文件夹尚未受信任。请先在该文件夹中启动会话后重试。

original: That session’s folder no longer exists on this computer.
translation: 这台电脑上已不存在该会话的文件夹。

original: Couldn’t confirm that session isn’t open in a terminal. If it is, close it there, then try again.
translation: 无法确认该会话是否在终端中打开。如果已打开，请先在终端关闭后重试。

original: Get {amount} in usage credits when you run it
translation: 运行后可获 {amount} 使用额度

original: Get usage credits when you run it
Something went wrong when adding your usage credits. Contact support for help.
translation: 添加使用额度时出错。请联系支持。

original: <added>{amount} of usage credits added</added> — thanks for trying the feature of the week <cmd>/{command}</cmd>
translation: <added>已添加 {amount} 使用额度</added> — 感谢试用本周功能 <cmd>/{command}</cmd>

original: <added>Usage credits added</added> — thanks for trying the feature of the week <cmd>/{command}</cmd>
translation: <added>使用额度已添加</added> — 感谢试用本周功能 <cmd>/{command}</cmd>

original: The model is still loading. Try /{commandName} again in a moment.
translation: 模型仍在加载。请稍后再次尝试 /{commandName}。

original: The permission mode can’t be changed for this session.
translation: 无法更改此会话的权限模式。

original: Context settings work once this session starts. Send your first message to start it.
translation: 会话启动后才能使用上下文设置。请发送第一条消息以启动。

original: Command copied. Paste it in a terminal to open this session.
translation: 命令已复制。粘贴到终端即可打开此会话。

original: /{commandName} only works in Claude Code in a terminal.
translation: /{commandName} 仅适用于终端中的 Claude Code。

original: Auto mode is now Claude Code’s default permission mode
translation: 自动模式现已成为 Claude Code 的默认权限模式

original: Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically. Claude checks each tool call for risky actions and prompt injection before executing, runs the ones it assesses as lower-risk, and blocks the rest.
translation: 自动模式让 Claude 自动处理权限提示。执行前，Claude 会检查每个工具调用中的高风险操作和提示词注入，仅运行评估为较低风险的调用，并阻止其他调用。
了解更多关于<docsLink>权限模式</docsLink>的信息。

original: Up to {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} scheduled, more than most workflows use.
translation: 最多安排{agents, plural, one {# 个智能体} other {# 个智能体}}，超过大多数工作流的用量。

original: As many as {tokens} tokens projected, more than most workflows use.
translation: 预计最多使用 {tokens} 个 Token，超过大多数工作流的用量。

original: Up to {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} scheduled, about {tokens} tokens projected.
translation: 最多安排{agents, plural, one {# 个智能体} other {# 个智能体}}，预计约使用 {tokens} 个 Token。

original: This workflow is larger than most.
translation: 此工作流的规模超过大多数工作流。

original: Couldn’t move this session to the cloud. Try again, or keep working here.
translation: 无法将此会话移至云端。请重试，或继续在这里工作。

original: Git for Windows is required to use a worktree. To continue without Git, turn off the worktree option.
translation: 使用 Git 工作树需要 Git for Windows。如需不使用 Git 继续，请关闭 Git 工作树选项。

original: Git for Windows is required to run local sessions. If it’s already installed, set the {envVar} environment variable to the full path of bash.exe and restart the app — or switch to a remote environment.
translation: 运行本地会话需要 Git for Windows。如果已安装，请将环境变量 {envVar} 设置为 bash.exe 的完整路径并重启应用，或切换到远程环境。

original: Git is required to use a worktree. To continue without Git, turn off the worktree option. To install Git, run {command} in Terminal or select Download Git.
translation: 使用 Git 工作树需要 Git。如需不使用 Git 继续，请关闭 Git 工作树选项。如需安装 Git，请在终端运行 {command} 或选择“下载 Git”。

original: Git is required to use a worktree. You can press Enter in the terminal to install Git with Apple’s Command Line Tools, or turn off the worktree option to continue without Git.
translation: 使用 Git 工作树需要 Git。你可以在终端按 Enter，通过 Apple 命令行工具安装 Git，或关闭 Git 工作树选项以继续。

original: Git for Windows is required to use a worktree. You can press Enter in the terminal to install it with winget and follow its prompts, or turn off the worktree option to continue without Git.
translation: 使用 Git 工作树需要 Git for Windows。你可以在终端按 Enter，通过 winget 安装并按提示操作，或关闭 Git 工作树选项以继续。

original: Git is required to use a worktree. To continue without Git, turn off the worktree option. To install Git, use your distribution’s package manager (for example, {command}).
translation: 使用 Git 工作树需要 Git。如需不使用 Git 继续，请关闭 Git 工作树选项。如需安装 Git，请使用发行版的软件包管理器，例如 {command}。

original: Git is installed, but it failed to start. This usually means it can’t read its configuration file. If the error below says “Operation not permitted”, grant Claude Full Disk Access in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then try again.
translation: 已安装 Git，但启动失败，通常是无法读取配置文件。如果下方错误为“Operation not permitted”，请在“系统设置 → 隐私与安全”中授予 Claude 完全磁盘访问权限后重试。

original: Git is installed, but it failed to start. This usually means it can’t read a configuration file. Check your Git configuration, then try again.
translation: 已安装 Git，但启动失败，通常是无法读取配置文件。请检查 Git 配置后重试。

original: Git was found at {path}, but your system blocked Claude from running it. This is usually an endpoint security or application control policy. Ask your IT team to allow Claude to run Git, or switch to a remote environment.
translation: 在 {path} 找到了 Git，但系统阻止 Claude 运行它，通常是终端安全或应用控制策略所致。请让 IT 团队允许 Claude 运行 Git，或切换到远程环境。

original: Git is installed, but your system blocked Claude from running it. This is usually an endpoint security or application control policy. Ask your IT team to allow Claude to run Git, or switch to a remote environment.

translation: 如果你信任此工作区，请重试，并在出现提示时选择“信任此工作区”。

translation: 在发送下一条消息前压缩上下文，可让后续回复更快，并减少用量。

translation: MCP 工具结果会一直保留在本次会话的上下文中。压缩上下文可以清除这些结果，也可以停用不需要的服务器。

translation: 请重新连接 GitHub，或确认你的 GitHub 账户有权访问此仓库。

original: Too many preview requests are in flight for this session. This usually means a heavy app loading cold on a dev server, not other browser tabs. Ask Claude to build it for preview, or wait a minute and retry.

translation: Claude 需要你批准才能使用工具。

translation: 加载时出现问题。请尝试重新打开。

translation: 只有组织管理员更新你的角色后，重新连接才会生效。

translation: 你的 GitHub 登录已失效。请重新连接 GitHub 以继续。

translation: 你的组织要求 Claude 每次运行工作流时都获得批准。
仍在设置 Claude 的工作区

original: The distribution’s managed settings couldn’t be applied, or they don’t allow the version installed there. The details show what needs to change. If you don’t manage that distribution, send the details to its admin.

translation: 模型负载过高时，可以直接从错误卡片的重试菜单选择其他模型

translation: 你可以在计划模式下，或在 Claude 请求批准时，对计划发表评论。

translation: 已与远程会话断开连接。请发送消息或刷新以重新连接。

translation: {serverName} 未连接。如果你没有取消登录，请联系你的 {serverName} 管理员获取访问权限。

translation: 请检查可用磁盘空间和会话文件夹的权限，然后在启动本会话的原会话中，请 Claude 再次启动它。

original: Shell commands that run persistently in the background for the whole session.
translation: 在整个会话期间持续在后台运行的 Shell 命令。

original: You’re approaching your {limitName}. It resets at {resetTime} on {resetDay}. To keep working without interruption:
translation: 你即将达到{limitName}。用量会在 {resetDay} 的 {resetTime} 重置。要保持工作不中断：

original: Couldn’t load connector permissions. Try again shortly.
translation: 无法加载连接器权限。请稍后重试。

original: Installs to .claude/ — shared with your team via Git.
translation: 安装到 .claude/，通过 Git 与团队共享。

original: Needs authentication. Sign in with /mcp in a terminal on {host}, then reconnect here.
translation: 需要身份验证。请在 {host} 的终端中使用 /mcp 登录，然后回到此处重新连接。

original: The connector directory couldn’t be loaded, so some connector options may be missing. Reload the page to retry.
translation: 无法加载连接器目录，因此可能缺少部分连接器选项。请重新加载页面以重试。

translation: 请在运行此会话的电脑的终端中使用 /mcp 登录。

original: Not enough disk space to set up the workspace. Free up space and try again.
translation: 没有足够的磁盘空间来设置工作区。请释放空间后重试。

original: Enter this code in the browser tab, then approve.
translation: 请在浏览器标签页中输入此代码，然后批准。

original: {name} will be uninstalled from this computer. You can add it again from this marketplace.
translation: {name} 将从此电脑卸载。你可以从此市场重新添加。

original: Spend limits are still loading. Try again in a moment.
translation: 消费限额仍在加载。请稍后重试。

original: Reinstall Claude, or repair the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable.
translation: 请重新安装 Claude，或修复 Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable。

original: Your environment couldn’t start a runner — retrying in ~{eta} (attempt {attempt})
translation: 你的环境无法启动运行器，将在约 {eta} 后重试（第 {attempt} 次尝试）

translation: 连接已断开，你的组织配置的 ssh 程序已无法在此电脑上使用。请联系 IT 管理员，然后重新连接。

original: Your GitHub organization requires single sign-on (SSO). Reconnect to authorize it.
translation: 你的 GitHub 组织要求单点登录（SSO）。请重新连接以授权。

original: This skill is now enabled for your account, but Claude couldn’t sync just now. It will install the next time a sync succeeds.
translation: 此技能已为你的账户启用，但 Claude 刚才无法同步。下次同步成功时会进行安装。

original: The session reconnects as soon as you do.
translation: 你重新连接后，会话也会立即重新连接。

original: Not sent to Claude. Open the {where, select, session {session} other {conversation}} to sign in again, then send it again.
translation: 未发送给 Claude。请打开{where, select, session {会话} other {对话}}重新登录，然后再次发送。

original: The connection dropped, and the key file for {host} is a PuTTY .ppk that couldn’t be used. Export it as an OpenSSH key (PuTTYgen → Conversions), use that file, then reconnect.
translation: 连接已断开，{host} 的密钥文件为 PuTTY .ppk 格式，无法使用。请将其导出为 OpenSSH 密钥（PuTTYgen → Conversions），使用导出的文件，然后重新连接。

original: {name} will reconnect when it’s next used.
translation: {name} 将在下次使用时重新连接。

original: A zip of the conversation is saved to your Downloads folder; nothing is uploaded.
translation: 对话的 zip 文件已保存到你的“下载”文件夹；没有上传任何内容。
请重新连接以使用此 Artifact

original: This plugin is now enabled for your account, but it hasn’t reached this computer yet. It will finish installing the next time Claude syncs your plugins.
translation: 此插件已为你的账户启用，但尚未同步到此电脑。Claude 下次同步插件时会完成安装。

original: This artifact is too large to save as Markdown. Download the page file instead.
translation: 此 Artifact 太大，无法保存为 Markdown。请改为下载页面文件。

original: Turning this on asks for administrator permission once.
translation: 启用此选项时，会请求一次管理员权限。

original: To limit where Claude can act without turning it off, choose the sites Claude can use under Site permissions on this page.
translation: 要限制 Claude 可操作的网站而不将其关闭，请在此页面的“网站权限”中选择 Claude 可以使用的网站。

original: Couldn’t save tool permission restriction. Your change was reverted.
translation: 无法保存工具权限限制。你的更改已撤回。

original: Install the GitHub CLI on this computer, then sign in to it.
translation: 请在此电脑上安装 GitHub CLI，然后登录。

original: A plugin named “{pluginName}” is already installed. This will overwrite the current version with your local copy.
translation: 已安装名为“{pluginName}”的插件。此操作会使用你的本地副本覆盖当前版本。

original: Paused until this computer ({name}) reconnects or you re-enable it.
translation: 已暂停，直到此电脑（{name}）重新连接，或你重新启用。

original: This environment has {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in its work queue. Deleting it will interrupt any in-progress work. This action can’t be undone.
translation: 此环境的工作队列中有 {count, plural, one {# 个项目} other {# 个项目}}。删除环境会中断正在进行的工作。此操作无法撤销。

original: GitHub CLI unavailable. Install it on this computer, then sign in to it.
translation: GitHub CLI 不可用。请在此电脑上安装并登录。
需要获得使用 {host} 的权限
