original: No API resource scope set. On IdPs where the requested scopes decide the access-token audience (e.g. Entra ID), this yields a token for the IdP’s own APIs, not your gateway or proxy. Add its API scope (Entra: api://APP_ID/.default). Ignore this if your IdP sets the token audience out-of-band (Keycloak audience mapper, Auth0 default audience, Okta custom-AS audience).
translation: 未设置 API 资源作用域。对于由请求作用域决定访问令牌受众的 IdP（如 Entra ID），生成的令牌用于 IdP 自身的 API，而非网关或代理。请添加对应的 API 作用域（Entra：api://APP_ID/.default）。若 IdP 通过其他方式设置令牌受众（Keycloak 受众映射器、Auth0 默认受众、Okta 自定义授权服务器受众），可忽略此提示。
网关 SSO 身份提供商（OIDC）

original: When true, sessions for users signed in through the gateway’s own sign-in run Claude Code in its gateway mode. Gateway provider only. Default false.
translation: 开启后，通过网关自身登录流程登录的用户，其会话会以网关模式运行 Claude Code。仅适用于 Gateway 提供商，默认关闭。

original: Enables in-app AWS sign-in (no AWS CLI needed). Set with the three SSO fields below.
translation: 启用应用内 AWS 登录，无需 AWS CLI。请同时设置下方三个 SSO 字段。
IAM Identity Center 的主区域。

original: 12-digit AWS account ID assigned to users in IAM Identity Center.
translation: IAM Identity Center 为用户分配的 12 位 AWS 账户 ID。

original: IAM Identity Center permission-set name granting bedrock:InvokeModel* on the account above.
translation: 在上述账户中授予 bedrock:InvokeModel* 权限的 IAM Identity Center 权限集名称。

original: Sent as the X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier header. Leave unset for on-demand.
translation: 作为 X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier 请求头发送。留空则使用按需服务。

original: IAM role for the Microsoft 365 add-in
translation: Microsoft 365 加载项的 IAM 角色

original: Role the Microsoft 365 add-in assumes with the user’s Entra ID token (STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity). Not read by Claude Desktop.
translation: Microsoft 365 加载项通过用户的 Entra ID 令牌承担的角色（STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity）。Claude Desktop 不读取此项。

original: Desktop-app OAuth client ID. Enables Sign in with Google instead of a credentials file.
translation: 桌面应用的 OAuth 客户端 ID。启用 Google 登录，替代凭据文件。

original: Secret for the Desktop-app OAuth client above. Google classifies installed-app client secrets as non-confidential, so this may be set from hosted config.
translation: 上述桌面应用 OAuth 客户端的密钥。Google 将已安装应用的客户端密钥视为非机密信息，因此可由托管配置设置。

original: Override the Google OAuth scopes (space-separated). Leave blank for the default.
translation: 覆盖 Google OAuth 作用域，以空格分隔。留空使用默认值。
员工身份联合的身份提供商（OIDC）

original: Absolute path to service-account JSON. Leave blank to fall back to ADC.
translation: 服务账户 JSON 文件的绝对路径。留空则回退到 ADC。

original: GCP region where your Vertex AI Claude models are deployed.
translation: 部署 Vertex AI Claude 模型的 GCP 区域。
如果使用 PSC，填写其端点。

original: Azure AI Foundry resource name used to construct the endpoint URL.
translation: 用于构造端点 URL 的 Azure AI Foundry 资源名称。
Azure AI Foundry 基础 URL

original: Full base URL for a gateway or proxy in front of Foundry, path included (replaces https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic).
translation: Foundry 前方网关或代理的完整基础 URL，包含路径（替代 https://RESOURCE.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic）。

original: Static token sent as Authorization: Bearer. Prefer a helper script or sign-in.
translation: 作为 Authorization: Bearer 发送的静态令牌。建议使用助手脚本或登录流程。

original: HTTPS endpoint of the self-hosted session host (beta).
translation: 自托管会话主机的 HTTPS 端点（测试版）。

original: Shown in the skill list and used to run the skill. It replaces any skill a user added with the same name.
translation: 显示在技能列表中，并用于运行技能。将替换用户添加的同名技能。

original: Shown under the name in the skill list. Claude reads it to decide when to use the skill.
translation: 显示在技能列表的名称下方。Claude 据此决定何时使用该技能。

original: Where the add-in downloads the skill: a zip or a SKILL.md file. A pre-signed storage URL works.
translation: 加载项下载技能的位置：ZIP 或 SKILL.md 文件。支持预签名存储 URL。

original: The add-in refuses a download with any other SHA-256, so a file that changed after you added it can’t install. Recommended.
translation: 若下载文件的 SHA-256 不同，加载项会拒绝下载，因此添加后发生变化的文件无法安装。建议设置。

original: Skills the Microsoft 365 add-in installs for every user.
translation: Microsoft 365 加载项为每位用户安装的技能。

original: How fetches authenticate: anonymously, with the user’s git credentials, via a helper executable, or as the app does to its gateway or bootstrap server (url).
translation: 获取内容时的认证方式：匿名、用户的 Git 凭据、助手程序，或应用访问网关或引导服务器时使用的方式（url）。

original: Executable that prints an access token for this marketplace.
translation: 输出此市场访问令牌的程序。
marketplace.json 的 64 位十六进制 SHA-256

original: SHA-256 of the exact marketplace.json to accept. Without it auto_install and required act as available; a served manifest with any other digest is refused.
translation: 允许接收的 marketplace.json 文件的精确 SHA-256。未设置时，auto_install 和 required 均按 available 处理；提供的清单摘要不符时会被拒绝。

original: Where the marketplace is fetched from: a GitHub repository (set repo), any Git remote (set url), or a hosted marketplace.json file (set url).
translation: 获取市场的位置：GitHub 仓库（设置 repo）、任意 Git 远程仓库（设置 url），或托管的 marketplace.json 文件（设置 url）。

original: HTTPS Git remote of the marketplace repository (git), or direct HTTPS URL of a hosted marketplace.json file (url).
translation: 市场仓库的 HTTPS Git 远程地址（git），或托管 marketplace.json 文件的直接 HTTPS URL（url）。

original: GitHub repository in owner/repo form. Case-insensitive.
translation: 以 owner/repo 格式填写 GitHub 仓库，不区分大小写。

original: Automatic installation needs {source, select, url {a Manifest SHA-256} other {a full 40-character commit SHA in Ref}}. Without one this marketplace is treated as available: it is listed, but this setting installs nothing.
translation: 自动安装需要{source, select, url {清单 SHA-256} other {“版本引用”中的完整 40 位提交 SHA}}。未设置时，此市场按可用处理：会显示在列表中，但此设置不会安装任何内容。

original: HTTPS address each published item is POSTed to, with no query or fragment. Plain http on a loopback host is taken only from device management or the local file.
translation: 每个发布项通过 POST 发送到的 HTTPS 地址，不得包含查询或片段。回环主机的普通 http 地址仅接受设备管理或本地文件配置。

original: What each request carries: nothing, a helper executable’s output as Authorization, or the credential the app already sends its gateway or bootstrap server.
translation: 每个请求携带的内容：无认证信息、作为 Authorization 的助手程序输出，或应用已发送给网关或引导服务器的凭据。

original: HTTPS endpoint that receives the skills and plugins users publish to the organization. When set, users get a Publish to organization action.
translation: 接收用户向组织发布的技能和插件的 HTTPS 端点。设置后，用户可执行“发布到组织”。

original: Allow users to add plugin marketplaces. When off, marketplaces your organization did not provision are hidden and the app’s sessions do not load their plugins.
translation: 允许用户添加插件市场。关闭后，隐藏组织未提供的市场，应用会话也不会加载这些市场的插件。

original: Transport protocol for the OpenTelemetry exporters.
translation: OpenTelemetry 导出器的传输协议。

original: Chats and Cowork tasks on Windows or behind an HTTP proxy, and the app’s own events, export over OTLP/HTTP to this same endpoint. Choose grpc only if the collector also accepts OTLP/HTTP there.
translation: Windows 上或使用 HTTP 代理的聊天和 Cowork 任务，以及应用自身事件，均通过 OTLP/HTTP 导出到同一端点。只有采集器也在该端点接受 OTLP/HTTP 时，才选择 grpc。

original: Static collector headers — routing and tenant headers only. No credentials here; use Collector authentication or the headers helper script for tokens.
translation: 采集器静态请求头，仅用于路由和租户信息。不含凭据；令牌请使用“采集器认证”或请求头助手脚本。

original: inference-credential sends the user’s inference bearer token to the collector as Authorization: Bearer.
translation: inference-credential 将用户的推理 Bearer 令牌作为 Authorization: Bearer 发送到采集器。

original: This sends the user’s inference token over plain http to another host. Use an https collector endpoint.
translation: 这会通过普通 http 将用户的推理令牌发送到另一台主机。请使用 https 采集器端点。

original: The configured inference credential is not sent as a bearer token, so telemetry will export without it. Use the headers helper script instead.
translation: 当前推理凭据不是以 Bearer 令牌发送，因此遥测导出不会携带该凭据。请改用请求头助手脚本。

original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a JSON object of collector headers. Merged over the static headers and Collector authentication; the helper wins.
translation: 输出采集器请求头 JSON 对象的程序绝对路径。与静态请求头及“采集器认证”合并，冲突时以助手输出为准。

original: Also export OpenTelemetry traces from Cowork tasks and Code sessions. Uses Claude Code’s session tracing.
translation: 同时导出 Cowork 任务和 Code 会话的 OpenTelemetry 跟踪，使用 Claude Code 的会话跟踪功能。

original: Maximum characters per content-bearing span attribute sent to the collector (256–32000). Default 4000. Read by the Microsoft 365 add-in.
translation: 发送到采集器的含内容 span 属性的最大字符数（256–32000），默认 4000。由 Microsoft 365 加载项读取。

original: Typically supplied by your bootstrap server when the gateway offers dictation.
translation: 网关提供听写功能时，通常由引导服务器提供。

original: Tumbling window length for the token cap. Max 720 hours (30 days).
translation: 令牌上限的固定统计窗口长度，最大 720 小时（30 天）。

original: This choice would leave no surface on. Turn on Code first.
translation: 此选择会关闭所有功能界面。请先开启 Code。

original: Desktop home decides this while it is set.
translation: 设置“桌面主页”后，由其决定此选项。

original: Unifies Chat and Cowork into one home. When set, it replaces Allow Chat, Advanced file analysis, and Allow Cowork. Leave unset to keep those.
translation: 将 Chat 和 Cowork 合并为一个主页。设置后替代“允许 Chat”“高级文件分析”和“允许 Cowork”。留空则保留这些选项。

original: The in-app catalogue of installable extensions. Hide to allow sideload only.
translation: 应用内可安装扩展的目录。隐藏后仅允许旁加载。

original: Security and compatibility fixes will not install automatically. Make sure IT has another distribution path.
translation: 安全和兼容性修复将不会自动安装。请确保 IT 部门有其他分发渠道。

original: Third-party deployments only. Auto-update stops at this version (X.Y.Z) and devices on newer versions cannot open Claude. Delays security fixes; leave unset.
translation: 仅适用于第三方部署。自动更新停止在此版本（X.Y.Z），已安装更新版本的设备无法打开 Claude。会延迟安全修复，建议留空。

original: Devices on a newer version cannot open Claude, and security fixes in newer releases do not install, until you raise or remove this cap.
translation: 在提高或取消此上限前，安装了更新版本的设备无法打开 Claude，新版本的安全修复也不会安装。

original: Fetch and apply the URL above at launch. Turn off to keep the URL saved but skip the fetch.
translation: 启动时获取并应用上述 URL。关闭后保留已保存的 URL，但不获取配置。

original: When set, the bootstrap request sends a Bearer token from a browser sign-in (authorization-code-with-PKCE).
translation: 设置后，引导请求发送通过浏览器登录取得的 Bearer 令牌（authorization-code-with-PKCE）。

original: HTTP headers sent on every bootstrap config fetch. Use this instead of embedding user:pass@ in the URL.
translation: 每次获取引导配置时发送的 HTTP 请求头。请使用此项，避免在 URL 中嵌入 user:pass@。

original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a JSON object of bootstrap request headers. Merged over the static headers; the helper wins.
translation: 输出引导请求头 JSON 对象的程序绝对路径。与静态请求头合并，冲突时以助手输出为准。

original: Skip the per-user consent prompt for sign-in targets, inference endpoints, helper scripts, and connectors the bootstrap server delivers.
translation: 跳过引导服务器提供的登录目标、推理端点、助手脚本及连接器的逐用户同意提示。

original: Keep only your organization ID and restrictions on disk
translation: 仅在磁盘保存组织 ID 和限制

original: Don’t keep your organization’s name or any permissive setting on disk between launches; only your organization ID and the restrictions you turn on are kept.
translation: 两次启动之间，不在磁盘保留组织名称或任何放宽权限的设置；仅保存组织 ID 和你开启的限制。

original: Model ID exactly as the provider expects it. The first entry is the default model.
translation: 提供商要求的精确模型 ID。第一项为默认模型。

original: Adds a 1M-context variant of this model to the picker. Set only if the deployment accepts 1M-token context for it.
translation: 在选择器中增加此模型的 1M 上下文变体。仅在部署支持该模型的 1M 令牌上下文时设置。

original: When several models share a tier alias, marks this one as the model the alias resolves to. Otherwise the first listed wins.
translation: 多个模型共用层级别名时，将此模型指定为别名解析的目标。否则以列表中第一项为准。

original: Highest effort level offered for this model; higher levels are hidden and never requested by Claude Desktop. An unrecognized value caps the model at low.
translation: 此模型可用的最高投入度。更高投入度会隐藏，Claude Desktop 也不会请求它们。无法识别的值会将模型投入度上限设为 low。

original: Oldest Claude Desktop version that can use this model, as three numbers like 2.2553.0. Older apps that read this setting grey the model out and ask to update.
translation: 可使用此模型的最低 Claude Desktop 版本，以三个数字表示，如 2.2553.0。读取此设置的旧版应用会将模型置灰并提示更新。

original: Scales every estimated cost (0.85 = 85% of the price); between 0 and 1.
translation: 按比例调整所有预估费用（0.85 表示价格的 85%），范围为 0 到 1。

original: A model ID from the list above, or any other ID or alias your provider serves. A built-in Claude ID also covers its dated and provider forms.
translation: 上述列表中的模型 ID，或提供商支持的其他 ID 或别名。内置 Claude ID 同时涵盖带日期和提供商格式的变体。
每百万输入令牌的美元价格。
每百万输出令牌的美元价格。

original: USD per million prompt-cache read tokens.
translation: 每百万提示缓存读取令牌的美元价格。

original: USD per million prompt-cache write tokens (5-minute and 1-hour writes alike).
translation: 每百万提示缓存写入令牌的美元价格（5 分钟及 1 小时写入均使用此价格）。

original: Per-model rates replacing Anthropic list price in the Usage page’s estimate.
translation: 在“用量”页面的费用估算中，以各模型费率替代 Anthropic 官方牌价。

original: Connector favicons, artifact-preview and MCP Apps iframes, and the Linux spellcheck dictionary. Connector widgets fall back to text; spellcheck is off on Linux.
translation: 连接器图标、Artifact 预览及 MCP Apps iframe，以及 Linux 拼写检查词典。连接器小组件会回退为文本，Linux 上的拼写检查将关闭。

original: This disables connector icons, hosted artifact previews and MCP Apps widgets, and also turns spellcheck off on Linux. Artifacts still render locally, without CDN libraries; connectors that return MCP Apps show the text tool result instead of the widget.
translation: 关闭连接器图标、托管的 Artifact 预览和 MCP Apps 小组件，同时关闭 Linux 拼写检查。Artifact 仍在本地渲染，但不使用 CDN 库；返回 MCP Apps 的连接器会显示文本工具结果，替代小组件。

original: Report usage metrics to your Claude.ai organization
translation: 向你的 Claude.ai 组织报告用量指标

original: Set by the control plane from the organization’s Claude Code analytics setting; not editable here. Reports per-user token, cost and session counts (no content).
translation: 由控制平面根据组织的 Claude Code 分析设置提供，无法在此编辑。报告每位用户的令牌数、费用和会话数，不包含内容。

original: Endpoint is plain HTTP; auth credentials travel in cleartext.
translation: 端点使用普通 HTTP，认证凭据会以明文传输。

original: Shared bearer token: every org member authenticates as the same identity.
translation: 共享 Bearer 令牌：所有组织成员均以同一身份认证。

original: Start the pattern with a scheme such as https://, or *:// for any scheme: Claude Code compares a pattern with the server’s full address.
translation: 模式须以 https:// 等协议开头，任意协议使用 *://：Claude Code 会将模式与服务器完整地址比较。

original: Set by the control plane from the organization’s Claude in Chrome admin setting; not editable here. Lets sessions drive the user’s browser via the extension.
translation: 由控制平面根据组织的 Claude in Chrome 管理设置提供，无法在此编辑。允许会话通过扩展操作用户的浏览器。

original: Enable password managers in Claude in Chrome
translation: 在 Claude in Chrome 中启用密码管理器

original: Set by the control plane from the organization’s Password managers setting under Claude in Chrome; not editable here. Lets a password manager fill sign-ins.
translation: 由控制平面根据 Claude in Chrome 下的组织密码管理器设置提供，无法在此编辑。允许密码管理器填写登录信息。

original: URL pattern a plugin’s remote server must match, with * wildcards.
translation: 插件远程服务器必须匹配的 URL 模式，支持 * 通配符。

original: URL pattern of the remote servers to block, with * wildcards.
translation: 要阻止的远程服务器的 URL 模式，支持 * 通配符。
禁止连接的插件 MCP 服务器

original: Remote servers plugins may not connect, even if the allowed list admits them; in Code sessions, configuration-file servers too. Unset or empty blocks none.
translation: 插件不可连接的远程服务器，即使允许列表包含它们也不例外；在 Code 会话中也适用于配置文件中的服务器。留空或未设置则不阻止任何服务器。

original: Absolute folder path. May start with ~ or one of the listed %VAR% tokens, expanded per user. Subfolders are included.
translation: 文件夹的绝对路径，可使用 ~ 或列出的 %VAR% 标记开头，按用户展开。包含子文件夹。

original: Approval policy per built-in tool or argument-scoped rule such as Bash(curl *). “ask” requires user approval before each matching call; “allow” is the default.
translation: 各内置工具或参数限定规则（如 Bash(curl *)）的批准策略。“ask”要求每次匹配调用前由用户批准；“allow”为默认值。

original: Offer Auto mode in the Code permission selector (on unless set to false); set to true to also offer it in Cowork. Claude decides which actions need approval.
translation: 在 Code 权限选择器中提供自动模式（除非设为 false，否则默认开启）；设为 true 时，Cowork 也会提供该模式。Claude 决定哪些操作需要批准。
使用 Claude Code 企业启动器

original: Start Claude Code through the launcher in Claude Code’s managed settings (processWrapper) — this device’s, and an SSH host’s for SSH sessions. Off by default.
translation: 通过 Claude Code 托管设置中的启动器（processWrapper）启动 Claude Code：本地会话使用此设备的启动器，SSH 会话使用 SSH 主机的启动器。默认关闭。

original: Move app data off network shares
translation: 将应用数据移出网络共享

original: Store app data in local AppData on Windows devices where Roaming AppData is redirected to a network share, which Cowork tasks cannot run from.
translation: 在 Windows 设备的 Roaming AppData 被重定向到网络共享时，将应用数据存入本地 AppData，因为 Cowork 任务无法从网络共享运行。

original: Path on the user’s computer to the signed package an endpoint security (EDR) vendor supplies for the Cowork workspace VM. Read from device management only.
translation: 终端安全（EDR）厂商为 Cowork 工作区虚拟机提供的签名包在用户电脑上的路径。仅从设备管理读取。

original: The ID of the vendor that signed the package coworkEDRIntegration points to. Required with that key, or nothing is installed. Read from device management only.
translation: 对 coworkEDRIntegration 指定的包进行签名的厂商 ID。须与该键同时提供，否则不安装任何内容。仅从设备管理读取。

original: Runs tools inside an isolated VM instead of the host. Stronger isolation; slower file access and no host-process tools.
translation: 在隔离虚拟机内而非宿主机运行工具。隔离更强，但文件访问较慢，且不支持宿主进程工具。

original: The default host-native mode starts faster and works behind restricted networks. Shell commands run inside the VM; file tools run on the host with path-based access control. Enable this only if your security review requires the agent loop itself to run in the VM.
translation: 默认的宿主原生模式启动更快，也可在受限网络后运行。Shell 命令在虚拟机内执行，文件工具在宿主机按路径控制访问。仅在安全审查要求智能体循环本身也在虚拟机内运行时开启此项。

original: Restricts login to specific org UUID(s). Single UUID string or JSON array.
translation: 将登录限制为指定的组织 UUID。可填写单个 UUID 字符串或 JSON 数组。

original: Keep Claude Desktop signed in to one account at a time.
translation: Claude Desktop 一次只能登录一个账户。

original: Import earlier third-party sessions into this organization
translation: 将此前的第三方会话导入此组织

original: After sign-in to this organization, copies this computer’s earlier third-party sessions into the user’s local first-party profile, once per account and org.
translation: 登录此组织后，将此电脑此前的第三方会话复制到用户的本地官方账户配置中。每个账户与组织组合仅执行一次。

original: “disabled” forces browser-based Microsoft 365 sign-in; “required” fails sign-in when the OS broker is unavailable, so the refresh token stays broker-held.
translation: “disabled”强制通过浏览器登录 Microsoft 365；“required”在操作系统认证代理不可用时使登录失败，确保刷新令牌始终由代理持有。
允许可选的客户端证书回退

original: Turns the banner on. When false or unset, the other banner fields are ignored.
translation: 启用横幅。设为 false 或留空时，其他横幅字段均被忽略。

original: Single line, truncated on overflow. Maximum 200 characters.
translation: 单行显示，超出后截断。最多 200 个字符。

original: Six-digit hex (#RRGGBB). Applied exactly as configured; not theme-adapted.
translation: 六位十六进制颜色（#RRGGBB），按配置原样应用，不随主题调整。

original: Optional HTTPS URL. The banner text becomes a link when set.
translation: 可选的 HTTPS URL。设置后，横幅文字会变成链接。

original: Endpoint that returns a signed-in user’s Claude.ai conversation history. Only needed for importing directly from Claude.ai.
translation: 返回已登录用户的 Claude.ai 对话历史的端点。仅直接从 Claude.ai 导入时需要。

original: OAuth server users sign in to before importing directly from Claude.ai. Set with the export URL and client ID, or leave all three empty.
translation: 用户直接从 Claude.ai 导入前登录的 OAuth 服务器。请与导出 URL 及客户端 ID 一起设置，或三项均留空。

original: OAuth client ID this app presents to the OAuth issuer. Set with the export URL and OAuth issuer, or leave all three empty.
translation: 此应用提交给 OAuth 签发方的客户端 ID。请与导出 URL 及 OAuth 签发方一起设置，或三项均留空。

original: Prompt to import on a new chat or task. Off if unset. `show`: always; needs `enabled` or a sign-in import. `detect`: if `enabled` finds earlier Claude sessions.
translation: 在新聊天或任务中提示导入。留空则关闭。`show`：始终提示，需要 `enabled` 或登录时导入。`detect`：仅在 `enabled` 找到此前 Claude 会话时提示。
导入提示跳过次数上限

original: Skips allowed before the import prompt stays hidden: 1 to 10, 1 if unset. It returns 3 days after each skip except the last. An import hides it for good.
translation: 导入提示永久隐藏前可跳过的次数：1 到 10，留空为 1。除最后一次外，每次跳过后 3 天会再次提示。完成导入后永久隐藏。

original: Your organization’s Entra app registration for the Microsoft 365 add-in. Leave unset to use the add-in’s published application.
translation: 组织为 Microsoft 365 加载项注册的 Entra 应用。留空则使用加载项已发布的应用。

original: Microsoft cloud the add-in signs in against. Any cloud other than global requires your own app registration (client ID).
translation: 加载项登录的 Microsoft 云环境。除 global 外的云环境均需要自行注册应用（客户端 ID）。

original: This cloud has no published add-in application: set the client ID of your own registration.
translation: 此云环境没有已发布的加载项应用：请设置自行注册应用的客户端 ID。

original: Custom scopes are only requested through your own app registration: set the client ID.
translation: 只有通过自行注册的应用才会请求自定义作用域：请设置客户端 ID。

original: Delegated scopes the add-in requests (space- or comma-separated, all for one resource), e.g. your gateway’s api://…/.default. Requires your own client ID.
translation: 加载项请求的委托作用域，以空格或逗号分隔，均须属于同一资源，如网关的 api://…/.default。需要自己的客户端 ID。

original: Label GUIDs keep matching when a label is renamed. Label names must match exactly, including case.
translation: 标签重命名后，标签 GUID 仍可匹配。标签名称必须完全一致，包括大小写。

original: Matches a file that has this label.
translation: 匹配带有此标签的文件。

original: Matches every label whose name starts with this text, for example all sublabels of one parent label.
translation: 匹配名称以此文本开头的所有标签，例如某个父标签的全部子标签。

original: Matches every label whose name ends with this text.
translation: 匹配名称以此文本结尾的所有标签。

original: Any label matches every labeled file. No label matches unlabeled files and, for uploads, files that can’t have a label, such as images.
translation: “任意标签”匹配所有已标记文件。“无标签”匹配未标记文件；上传时也匹配无法标记的文件，如图像。

original: Open file checks the document the add-in runs in. Uploaded file checks each file the user attaches. A statement checks only the type it names.
translation: “已打开文件”检查加载项所在的文档。“已上传文件”检查用户附加的每个文件。每条策略仅检查其指定的文件类型。

original: The statement applies to a file when any of these match its label.
translation: 文件标签匹配其中任意一项时，此策略适用于该文件。

original: A note for administrators. It has no effect.
translation: 供管理员参考的备注，不影响行为。

original: Deny turns the actions off for matching files. Allow turns them off for every other file of that type. Deny wins when both match.
translation: “拒绝”会关闭匹配文件的操作。“允许”会关闭该类型其他文件的操作。同时匹配时，以“拒绝”为准。

original: The features this statement turns off. “The add-in itself” covers the whole add-in.
translation: 此策略关闭的功能。“加载项本身”涵盖整个加载项。

original: The files this statement checks. A deny with no resource turns its actions off for every file.
translation: 此策略检查的文件。未指定资源的拒绝策略会对所有文件关闭对应操作。

original: Host applications where the Claude add-in for Microsoft 365 is turned off.
translation: 停用 Claude Microsoft 365 加载项的宿主应用。

original: Add-in features turned off for everyone, on every file. “The add-in itself” turns the whole add-in off.
translation: 对所有用户、所有文件关闭的加载项功能。“加载项本身”会关闭整个加载项。

original: Allow or deny add-in features by the Microsoft Purview sensitivity label of the open or attached file.
translation: 根据已打开或附加文件的 Microsoft Purview 敏感度标签，允许或拒绝加载项功能。
内置浏览器（站点安全检查）

original: Default site policy in the built-in browser
translation: 内置浏览器默认站点策略

original: Allow all sites except blocked sites
translation: 允许所有站点，已阻止站点除外

original: Block all sites except allowed sites
translation: 阻止所有站点，已允许站点除外

original: Whether Claude may open sites in the built-in browser by default; the allowed or blocked list is the exception. Mirrors the Claude in Chrome site policy.
translation: Claude 默认能否在内置浏览器中打开站点；允许或阻止列表作为例外。与 Claude in Chrome 站点策略对应。

original: Allowed sites in the built-in browser
translation: 内置浏览器允许的站点

original: Sites Claude may open, read, and act on in the built-in browser when the default site policy is block. Users can still view other sites.
translation: 默认策略为阻止时，Claude 可在内置浏览器中打开、读取和操作的站点。用户仍可查看其他站点。

original: Blocked sites in the built-in browser
translation: 内置浏览器阻止的站点

original: Sites Claude may not open, read, or act on in the built-in browser when the default site policy is allow. Users can still view them.
translation: 默认策略为允许时，Claude 不可在内置浏览器中打开、读取和操作的站点。用户仍可查看这些站点。

original: Selects the inference backend. Setting this key activates third-party mode.
translation: 选择推理后端。设置此键即启用第三方模式。

original: Hosts your network firewall must allow, derived from your current settings. This list is read-only and updates as you make changes. Traffic is HTTPS on port 443 unless an entry shows a port or starts with http://.
translation: 网络防火墙必须放行的主机，根据当前设置生成。此列表只读，随设置变化自动更新。除非条目指定端口或以 http:// 开头，否则均使用 HTTPS 443 端口。

original: This configuration is fetched from a bootstrap URL at launch. Fields it provides are locked below.
translation: 启动时从引导 URL 获取此配置。其提供的字段在下方锁定。

original: Path patterns go on {canonical}, which covers {tool}.
translation: 路径模式应设置在 {canonical} 上，该规则涵盖 {tool}。

original: Allow specific hosts with the egress host settings.
translation: 通过出站主机设置允许指定主机。

original: Replaces {count, plural, one {# scoped {tool} rule} other {# scoped {tool} rules}}
translation: 替换{count, plural, one { # 条 {tool} 限定规则} other { # 条 {tool} 限定规则}}

original: Server reachable but rejected the unauthenticated handshake. Choose an OAuth mode above to sign in, or add an Authorization header.
translation: 服务器可访问，但拒绝了未经认证的握手。请在上方选择 OAuth 模式登录，或添加 Authorization 请求头。

original: Your tenant may not be allowlisted yet — send the Client ID and Tenant ID above to your Anthropic representative (2-3 business days to activate).
translation: 你的租户可能尚未加入允许列表，请将上方客户端 ID 和租户 ID 提供给 Anthropic 联系人（启用需 2–3 个工作日）。

original: Duplicate key — only the last value is kept.
translation: 键重复，仅保留最后一个值。

original: Value does not match the required format.
MCP tool name as the server reports it.
translation: 服务器报告的 MCP 工具名称。

original: Approval state locked for this tool. Unlisted tools stay user-controlled.
translation: 此工具的批准状态已锁定。未列出的工具仍由用户控制。

original: Name of the plugin-delivered MCP server this policy applies to.
translation: 此策略适用的插件提供的 MCP 服务器名称。

original: Per-tool approval locks for this server.
translation: 此服务器各工具的批准状态锁定设置。

original: How the app connects: Streamable HTTP, legacy SSE, or a local command (stdio). policy-only connects to nothing; it only sets a plugin server’s tool policy.
translation: 应用的连接方式：Streamable HTTP、旧版 SSE 或本地命令（stdio）。policy-only 不连接任何服务器，仅设置插件服务器的工具策略。

original: Static headers sent on every request — routing and tenant headers only. No credentials here; use the headers helper script for tokens and rotating values.
translation: 每次请求发送的静态请求头，仅用于路由和租户信息。不含凭据；令牌和轮换值请使用请求头助手脚本。

original: How long the helper’s headers are reused before it runs again, in seconds. Defaults to 300.
translation: 助手请求头在重新运行助手前的复用秒数，默认 300。

original: Seconds before the TTL expires at which the helper re-runs mid-session. Defaults to 60. Keep it larger than the helper’s typical runtime.
translation: 会话中在 TTL 到期前多少秒重新运行助手，默认 60。应大于助手通常的运行时间。

original: Unique name for this server. Shown to users and used to key tool policy and sign-in state.
translation: 此服务器的唯一名称，向用户显示，并用作工具策略及登录状态的索引。

original: Lock the approval state for specific tools. Unlisted tools stay user-controlled.
translation: 锁定指定工具的批准状态。未列出的工具仍由用户控制。
来自 IdP 应用注册

original: OAuth client ID from your IdP app registration. Leave unset to auto-register (dynamic client registration) and only narrow scopes.
translation: IdP 应用注册的 OAuth 客户端 ID。留空则自动注册客户端（动态客户端注册），且仅缩小作用域。

original: Only for IdPs that require one (e.g. Box). Hosted config can store only a Google Desktop-app secret (GOCSPX-…); for other IdPs use the client secret helper.
translation: 仅在 IdP 要求时提供（如 Box）。托管配置只能存放 Google 桌面应用密钥（GOCSPX-…）；其他 IdP 请使用客户端密钥助手。

original: Executable that prints the client secret on stdout as a JSON object with a single clientSecret key; any other output is rejected. Overrides the inline value.
translation: 在 stdout 输出仅包含 clientSecret 键的 JSON 对象的程序；任何其他输出均被拒绝。覆盖直接填写的值。

original: Required when a client secret is configured. For a Google client use ["https://accounts.google.com"]; for mcp.box.com, ["https://api.box.com"].
translation: 配置客户端密钥时必填。Google 客户端使用 ["https://accounts.google.com"]；mcp.box.com 使用 ["https://api.box.com"]。

original: Required for single-tenant Entra apps. Leave blank for multi-tenant or non-Microsoft IdPs.
translation: 单租户 Entra 应用必填。多租户或非 Microsoft IdP 可留空。

original: Space-separated scopes sent on the authorize request. Leave unset to use the scopes the server advertises. Required when Tenant ID is set.
translation: 授权请求发送的作用域，以空格分隔。留空则使用服务器公布的作用域。设置租户 ID 时必填。

original: Scope is required when Tenant ID is set.
translation: 设置租户 ID 时，作用域为必填项。

original: Only set if your IdP requires an exact-match redirect port. Entra accepts any.
translation: 仅当 IdP 要求精确匹配重定向端口时设置。Entra 接受任意端口。

original: Set by the Claude.ai control plane when it serves this configuration (the URL of Anthropic’s hosted client-metadata document); not authored.
translation: 由 Claude.ai 控制平面提供此配置时设置（Anthropic 托管客户端元数据文档的 URL），无需自行填写。

original: Required: the exact issuer URL(s) this server’s OAuth authorization server advertises. Anthropic signs the client identity only for the servers listed here.
translation: 必填：此服务器的 OAuth 授权服务器公布的精确签发方 URL。Anthropic 仅为此处列出的服务器签署客户端身份。

original: The exact issuer string(s) the server’s OAuth authorization server advertises in its metadata, as a JSON array — matched exactly, including path and any trailing slash. Required: Anthropic signs the client identity only for an authorization server listed here.
translation: 服务器 OAuth 授权服务器在元数据中公布的精确签发方字符串，以 JSON 数组填写。须完全匹配，包括路径及末尾斜杠。必填：Anthropic 仅为此处列出的授权服务器签署客户端身份。

original: Choose a transport: Streamable HTTP or SSE for a remote server, or a local command (stdio).
translation: 选择传输方式：远程服务器使用 Streamable HTTP 或 SSE，本地命令使用 stdio。

original: HTTPS endpoint of the remote MCP server.
translation: 远程 MCP 服务器的 HTTPS 端点。
自动注册（动态客户端注册）
Anthropic 托管的客户端身份（需要 Claude.ai 登录）

original: OAuth for a remote server: true to auto-register a client, a pre-registered client ID with tenant and scope, or mode “hosted” for an Anthropic-signed identity.
translation: 远程服务器的 OAuth：true 表示自动注册客户端；也可提供预注册的客户端 ID、租户及作用域，或使用“hosted”模式获取 Anthropic 签署的身份。

original: Absolute path to an executable that prints a JSON object of HTTP headers on stdout. Merged over static headers; the helper wins on conflict.
translation: 在 stdout 输出 HTTP 请求头 JSON 对象的程序绝对路径。与静态请求头合并，冲突时以助手输出为准。

original: Arguments passed to the command, one per entry.
translation: 传给命令的参数，每项一个。

original: Environment variables set for the command.
translation: 为命令设置的环境变量。

original: Which bundled connector this entry turns on. Set instead of a transport; each built-in server has its own fields.
translation: 此条目启用的内置连接器。使用此项替代传输方式；每个内置服务器均有自己的字段。

original: Request CAE-capable Microsoft Graph tokens: long-lived (up to about 28 hours) but revocable within minutes. Set “disabled” to keep standard one-hour tokens.
translation: 请求支持 CAE 的 Microsoft Graph 令牌：有效期较长（最多约 28 小时），但可在数分钟内撤销。设为“disabled”则保留标准的一小时令牌。

original: Runs search from the desktop, for inference providers without native web search. Supply the provider’s API key through the headers helper script below.
translation: 在桌面执行搜索，供不支持原生网页搜索的推理提供商使用。通过下方请求头助手脚本提供其 API 密钥。

original: HTTPS issuer with OIDC discovery. Set this, or set the authorization and token URLs instead.
translation: 支持 OIDC 发现的 HTTPS 签发方。可设置此项，或改为设置授权 URL 和令牌 URL。

original: OAuth client ID of the desktop app registration at your identity provider (public client, PKCE).
translation: 桌面应用在身份提供商注册的 OAuth 客户端 ID（公共客户端，PKCE）。

original: HTTPS authorization endpoint. Used with the token URL when no issuer is set.
translation: HTTPS 授权端点。未设置签发方时，与令牌 URL 配合使用。

original: HTTPS token endpoint. Used with the authorization URL when no issuer is set.
translation: HTTPS 令牌端点。未设置签发方时，与授权 URL 配合使用。

original: Fixed loopback port for the sign-in redirect. Leave unset to use a free port each time.
translation: 登录重定向使用的固定回环端口。留空则每次使用空闲端口。

original: Space-separated scopes. Defaults to openid profile email offline_access.
translation: 以空格分隔的作用域。默认为 openid profile email offline_access。

original: Space-separated scopes. Required in access-token mode: set the gateway or proxy API scope. offline_access is appended automatically unless disabled below.
translation: 以空格分隔的作用域。访问令牌模式下必填，请设置网关或代理的 API 作用域。除非下方禁用，否则会自动附加 offline_access。

original: Access-token audience of the gateway or proxy: an https URL or an AD FS relying-party identifier, sent as the RFC 8707 resource. Leave unset for Entra ID.
translation: 网关或代理的访问令牌受众：HTTPS URL 或 AD FS 信赖方标识符，作为 RFC 8707 resource 发送。Entra ID 可留空。

original: {orgName} hasn’t finished setting up the Claude desktop app. Ask your admin to complete the setup.
translation: {orgName} 尚未完成 Claude 桌面应用配置。请联系管理员完成配置。

original: This chat couldn’t take your Quick Entry message right now, so it was put in the message box instead of being sent. You can send it from there.
translation: 此聊天暂时无法接收快捷输入消息，因此消息已放入输入框，尚未发送。你可以从输入框发送。

original: To change the instructions, model, permissions, or folders, use the Claude desktop app on {name}.
translation: 如需更改指令、模型、权限或文件夹，请使用 {name} 上的 Claude 桌面应用。

original: Where Claude Code users can learn more about setting up this MCP server.
translation: Claude Code 用户了解此 MCP 服务器配置方法的位置。

original: Community desktop extensions aren’t verified by Anthropic. We don’t control the tools they make available and can’t guarantee they’ll work as intended or won’t change, so only install desktop extensions from developers you trust. Learn more.
translation: 社区桌面扩展未经 Anthropic 验证。我们不控制其提供的工具，也无法保证工具按预期工作或不会发生变化。请仅安装来自可信开发者的桌面扩展。了解更多。

original: Continue this session in the cloud, or open Claude Code on that computer, sign in again, and start a new session.
translation: 请在云端继续此会话，或在对应电脑上打开 Claude Code，重新登录并开始新会话。

original: Claude Desktop on this session’s computer is switched to {otherOrg}. Switch it to {currentOrg} to reconnect.
translation: 此会话所在电脑的 Claude Desktop 已切换到 {otherOrg}。请切换到 {currentOrg} 后重新连接。

original: These permissions apply to Claude in Chrome and the built-in browser in the Claude desktop app.
translation: 这些权限适用于 Claude in Chrome 及 Claude 桌面应用的内置浏览器。

original: For security, Claude Code needs a recent sign-in.
translation: 出于安全考虑，Claude Code 需要最近的登录验证。

original: Claude started its own copy of Claude Code through your organization’s launcher, but a different version answered. Claude only works with the version it installed, so the session was ended. Contact your IT team.
translation: Claude 通过组织启动器启动了自己安装的 Claude Code，但响应来自其他版本。Claude 仅支持其安装的版本，因此会话已结束。请联系 IT 部门。

original: Couldn’t attach an image from Quick Entry; sending the message without it.
translation: 无法附加快捷输入中的图像，将不带图像发送消息。

original: SSH connected, but your home directory on {host} is on a read-only filesystem, so Claude Code couldn’t be installed. Remount it read-write or fix the disk on {host}, then try again.
translation: SSH 已连接，但 {host} 上的主目录位于只读文件系统，无法安装 Claude Code。请以读写方式重新挂载，或修复 {host} 上的磁盘后重试。

original: Claude Code doesn’t have permission to read a file or folder in your .claude folder.
translation: Claude Code 无权读取 .claude 文件夹中的某个文件或文件夹。

original: Claude only works with the version of Claude Code it installed on {host}, so it ended the session. Send the details to your IT team.
translation: Claude 仅支持其在 {host} 上安装的 Claude Code 版本，因此会话已结束。请将详细信息提供给 IT 部门。

original: Claude Code on the computer running this session has been signed out. Open Claude Code there and sign in again, then start a new session to continue.
translation: 运行此会话的电脑上的 Claude Code 已退出登录。请在那里打开 Claude Code 并重新登录，然后开始新会话。

original: Bypass permissions can’t be used when Claude Code runs as root. Run Claude Code as a non-root user, or turn off Allow bypass permissions mode in Settings → Claude Code.
translation: Claude Code 以 root 运行时，无法使用绕过权限模式。请使用非 root 用户运行，或在“设置 → Claude Code”中关闭“允许绕过权限模式”。

original: This copy of Claude Code was built for a different processor. Reinstall the version of Claude for this computer.
translation: 此 Claude Code 版本是为其他处理器构建的。请重新安装适用于此电脑的 Claude 版本。

original: The GitHub CLI enables creating PRs, monitoring CI, and merging directly from the desktop app. You can press Enter in the terminal to install it with winget and follow its prompts.
translation: GitHub CLI 可让你直接从桌面应用创建 PR、查看 CI 和合并。你可以在终端按 Enter，通过 winget 安装并按照提示操作。

original: Claude Code on {host} has been signed out. Open Claude Code there and sign in again, then start a new session to continue.
translation: {host} 上的 Claude Code 已退出登录。请在那里打开 Claude Code 并重新登录，然后开始新会话。

original: This device isn’t verified for Claude Code access. Sign in again to verify it, then change the effort.
translation: 此设备尚未通过 Claude Code 访问验证。请重新登录以验证设备，再更改投入度。

original: Claude Code on the computer running this session is offline. If that computer is asleep or lost its connection, this session reconnects when it’s back. If Claude Code was closed, start it there again and reopen this conversation.
translation: 运行此会话的电脑上的 Claude Code 已离线。如果电脑处于休眠或失去连接，恢复后会话会重新连接。如果 Claude Code 已关闭，请在那里重新启动，再打开此对话。

original: A message you sent is still waiting. The host is connected, but Claude Code didn’t start there. Retry or withdraw it below.
translation: 你发送的一条消息仍在等待。主机已连接，但 Claude Code 未在那里启动。请在下方重试或撤回。

original: “ANTHROPIC_API_KEY” won’t be used to authenticate requests. Claude Code sessions are authenticated through your Anthropic account.
translation: “ANTHROPIC_API_KEY”不会用于请求认证。Claude Code 会话通过你的 Anthropic 账户认证。

original: Your sign-in has expired for Claude Code access. Sign in again to change the effort on your device.
translation: 你的 Claude Code 访问登录已过期。请重新登录，再更改此设备上的投入度。

original: Claude Code on {host} is offline. If {host} is asleep or lost its connection, this session reconnects when it’s back. If Claude Code was closed, start it there again and reopen this conversation.
translation: {host} 上的 Claude Code 已离线。如果 {host} 处于休眠或失去连接，恢复后会话会重新连接。如果 Claude Code 已关闭，请在那里重新启动，再打开此对话。

original: Signing in again registers this device for Claude Code.
translation: 重新登录会为此设备注册 Claude Code。

original: Claude Code on {host} needs to sign in again
translation: {host} 上的 Claude Code 需要重新登录

original: To change the instructions, model, permissions, or folders, update the Claude desktop app.
translation: 如需更改指令、模型、权限或文件夹，请更新 Claude 桌面应用。

original: This task is linked to a different Claude desktop install. Add folders from that install, or start a new task here.
translation: 此任务关联了另一处 Claude 桌面安装。请从对应安装中添加文件夹，或在此开始新任务。

original: Marketplaces added with Claude Code on this computer. Removing one also uninstalls its plugins.
translation: 通过此电脑上的 Claude Code 添加的市场。移除市场也会卸载其插件。

original: This device isn’t verified for Claude Code access. Sign in again to verify it, then change the model.
translation: 此设备尚未通过 Claude Code 访问验证。请重新登录以验证设备，再更改模型。

original: Show Claude in the system tray.

Claude can’t reconnect to the Claude Code process that’s still running there, so it was left alone and its work so far is saved. Restart the remote session to start it fresh — anything it’s still doing, including background agents, will be lost.
translation: Claude 无法重新连接到仍在那里运行的 Claude Code 进程，因此保留了该进程及其已有工作。重启远程会话可重新开始，但该进程仍在进行的工作，包括后台智能体，将会丢失。

original: Log in with the same Claude account you use in Claude Desktop to finish connecting. You’ll choose which account to connect in the next step.
translation: 请使用与 Claude Desktop 相同的 Claude 账户登录以完成连接。下一步将选择要连接的账户。

original: This deletes the cookies, sign-ins, and site data the browser saves for every Code session and Cowork. You’ll need to sign in to sites again.
translation: 这会删除浏览器为所有 Code 会话和 Cowork 保存的 Cookie、登录状态及站点数据。之后需要重新登录各站点。

original: Your session has expired for Cowork access. Sign in again to reconnect this device.
translation: 你的 Cowork 访问会话已过期。请重新登录以重新连接此设备。

original: Couldn’t send the message from Quick Entry. Try again.
translation: 无法发送快捷输入消息。请重试。

original: Claude Code is installed on {host} but isn’t responding; give the host a minute, then try again.
translation: {host} 上已安装 Claude Code，但没有响应。请稍等片刻后重试。

original: Claude Code’s files are missing or damaged. Reinstall Claude to continue.
translation: Claude Code 的文件缺失或损坏。请重新安装 Claude 后继续。

original: Claude Code was busy, so the reconnect didn’t start. Try again in a moment.
translation: Claude Code 正忙，未能开始重新连接。请稍后重试。

original: Tasks created here run in the cloud and can’t use this computer’s folders or local tools. To run a task on this computer, create it from the desktop app.
translation: 在此创建的任务在云端运行，无法使用此电脑的文件夹或本地工具。如需在此电脑运行任务，请从桌面应用创建。

original: The connection dropped, and on reconnecting Claude Code on {host} wasn’t responding; give the host a minute, then reconnect.
translation: 连接已中断，重连时 {host} 上的 Claude Code 没有响应。请稍等片刻后重新连接。

original: Your sign-in has expired for Claude Code access. Sign in again to change the model on your device.
translation: 你的 Claude Code 访问登录已过期。请重新登录，再更改此设备上的模型。

original: This is a desktop extension. It runs locally in Claude Desktop — team members install it on their own computers, and it can’t be installed from the web.
translation: 这是桌面扩展，在 Claude Desktop 中本地运行。团队成员需在自己的电脑上安装，无法从网页安装。

original: Claude Desktop on this task’s computer is switched to {otherOrg}. Switch it to {currentOrg} to reconnect.
translation: 此任务所在电脑的 Claude Desktop 已切换到 {otherOrg}。请切换到 {currentOrg} 后重新连接。

original: To change the instructions, model, permissions, or folders, use the Claude desktop app on that computer.
translation: 如需更改指令、模型、权限或文件夹，请使用对应电脑上的 Claude 桌面应用。

original: Will run in the cloud only. To let it use a computer, approve from the Claude desktop app on that computer.
translation: 仅在云端运行。如需使用某台电脑，请从该电脑上的 Claude 桌面应用批准。

original: SSH connected, but {host} has no free disk space (or your quota there is used up), so Claude Code couldn’t be installed. Free some space on {host} — your home directory (Claude keeps its files under ~/.claude) or /tmp — then try again.
translation: SSH 已连接，但 {host} 没有可用磁盘空间，或你的配额已用尽，无法安装 Claude Code。请清理 {host} 的主目录（Claude 文件位于 ~/.claude）或 /tmp 后重试。

original: This chat can’t take new messages here, so your Quick Entry message wasn’t sent.
translation: 此聊天无法在此接收新消息，因此快捷输入消息未发送。

original: This browser is signed in as {email}. To connect {product} to the account you used in the desktop app, sign out here and sign in with that account.
translation: 此浏览器当前以 {email} 登录。如需将 {product} 连接到桌面应用使用的账户，请先在此退出，再使用对应账户登录。

original: expected a Bedrock model ID with the "anthropic." vendor prefix (e.g. anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-v1:0) or an inference-profile ARN
translation: 应填写带“anthropic.”厂商前缀的 Bedrock 模型 ID（如 anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-v1:0）或推理配置文件 ARN

original: Vertex model IDs cannot contain '/', '\', '?', '#', '%' or whitespace
translation: Vertex 模型 ID 不能包含 '/'、'\'、'?'、'#'、'%' 或空白字符

original: expected a Vertex Model Garden ID starting with "claude-" (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929)
translation: 应填写以“claude-”开头的 Vertex Model Garden ID（如 claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929）

original: expected a Foundry deployment name referencing an Anthropic model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5). Name deployments to match the underlying model.
translation: 应填写指向 Anthropic 模型的 Foundry 部署名称（如 claude-sonnet-4-5）。请按底层模型为部署命名。

original: expected an Anthropic model ID (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5)
translation: 应填写 Anthropic 模型 ID（如 claude-sonnet-4-5）

original: expected a gateway model route referencing an Anthropic model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, anthropic/claude-*). Name routes to match the underlying model.
translation: 应填写指向 Anthropic 模型的网关模型路由（如 claude-sonnet-4-5、anthropic/claude-*）。请按底层模型为路由命名。

original: must be a valid AWS region (e.g. us-east-1)
translation: 必须是有效的 AWS 区域（如 us-east-1）

original: must be a GCP region (e.g. us-east5), a multi-region ('eu'/'us'), or 'global'
translation: 必须是 GCP 区域（如 us-east5）、多区域（'eu'/'us'）或 'global'

original: must be an Azure resource name (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens)
translation: 必须是 Azure 资源名称（小写字母、数字和连字符）

original: must be a GCP project ID or number (e.g. my-gcp-project)
translation: 必须是 GCP 项目 ID 或编号（如 my-gcp-project）

original: no custom inference headers will be sent
translation: 不会发送自定义推理请求头

original: browser sign-in will no longer be inferred from it — the key will be reported as invalid and, unless inferenceCredentialKind or another credential field (an API key, inferenceGatewayOidc) says how to sign in, the gateway connection will have no credential and inference will not start
translation: 不再据此推断浏览器登录方式：此键将被报告为无效；除非 inferenceCredentialKind 或其他凭据字段（API 密钥、inferenceGatewayOidc）指定登录方式，否则网关连接将没有凭据，推理也无法启动

original: "bearer" (or remove the key — bearer is the default)
the value will be reported as invalid and ignored like any unrecognised scheme; the key will then take its default, "bearer", so the credential will still be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header
translation: 此值将像任何无法识别的方案一样被报告为无效并忽略；此键随后采用默认值 "bearer"，凭据仍以 Authorization: Bearer 请求头发送

original: "interactive" — the same Google sign-in under its new name (in hosted or nested documents, switch once every desktop is on a release that knows the Vertex "interactive" kind)
translation: "interactive"——同一种 Google 登录方式的新名称（对于托管或嵌套文档，请等所有桌面端升级到支持 Vertex "interactive" 类型的版本后再切换）

original: "oauth" will no longer be a Vertex AI credential kind: the value will be reported as invalid and ignored — the device will then derive the kind from the credential fields present (Google sign-in when an OAuth client id is set), and the hosted editor will refuse to save the configuration until the kind is changed
translation: "oauth" 不再是 Vertex AI 凭据类型：此值将被报告为无效并忽略；设备随后根据已有凭据字段推断类型（设置 OAuth 客户端 ID 时采用 Google 登录），托管编辑器则会拒绝保存，直到更改此类型

original: "workforce" — or remove inferenceVertexWorkforceAudience if Google sign-in ("interactive") is what is meant
translation: "workforce"——如果实际需要 Google 登录（"interactive"），则删除 inferenceVertexWorkforceAudience

original: the audience will no longer imply Workforce Identity: the kind will stay "interactive" (Google sign-in), which needs inferenceVertexOAuthClientId — without it the configuration will be reported as incomplete and inference will not start
translation: 不再根据受众推断 Workforce Identity：类型保持为 "interactive"（Google 登录），需要 inferenceVertexOAuthClientId；缺少此字段时配置将被报告为不完整，推理无法启动

original: the original spelling will keep working; no end date has been set
translation: 原写法仍可使用，尚未设定停止支持的日期

original: "external-idp" once every desktop in the fleet is on a release that reads it
translation: 等所有桌面端升级到支持该类型的版本后，改用 "external-idp"

original: the original spelling will keep working ("interactive" with inferenceGatewayOidc is read as "external-idp"); no end date has been set
translation: 原写法仍可使用（同时设置 "interactive" 和 inferenceGatewayOidc 时会按 "external-idp" 读取），尚未设定停止支持的日期

original: must be an IAM role ARN (e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ClaudeDesktop)
translation: 必须是 IAM 角色 ARN（如 arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ClaudeDesktop）

original: SHA-256 must be a 64-character hex digest
translation: SHA-256 必须是 64 位十六进制摘要

original: Credential helper is required when Auth is credentialHelper, and must be empty otherwise
translation: Auth 为 credentialHelper 时必须设置凭据助手，其他情况下必须留空

original: Expected name must start with a letter or number, may contain only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens, and must not end with a dot (128 characters max)
translation: 预期名称必须以字母或数字开头，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，不能以点结尾（最多 128 个字符）

original: Manifest SHA-256 must be a 64-character hex digest
translation: 清单 SHA-256 必须是 64 位十六进制摘要

original: Repository must be in the form owner/repo, e.g. anthropics/skills
translation: 仓库必须采用 owner/repo 格式，如 anthropics/skills
`ref` 中的完整 40 位提交 SHA

original: plugins will no longer be fetched or updated from that endpoint; the ones it already installed will stay until the key is removed from the configuration, which then retires them
translation: 不再从此端点获取或更新插件；已安装的插件会保留，直到从配置中删除此键，届时这些插件将被停用

original: no exporter headers will be sent
translation: 不会发送导出器请求头

original: no custom resource attributes will be attached
translation: 不会附加自定义资源属性

original: Must not carry a query string or fragment
translation: 不能包含查询字符串或片段

original: Must name a repository after the host
translation: 必须在主机名后指定仓库

original: The path may hold no percent-escape but %20
translation: 路径中的百分号转义只能使用 %20

original: The path must not hold an @
An owner/repo may only be the whole path
translation: owner/repo 必须占据整个路径

original: A two-part path is an owner and a repository: letters, numbers and . _ - (100 characters each), starting with a letter or number
translation: 两段路径分别为所有者和仓库：只能使用字母、数字和 . _ -，每段最多 100 个字符，并以字母或数字开头

original: Branch names can only use letters, numbers, and . _ / -
translation: 分支名称只能使用字母、数字和 . _ / -

original: Owner and repository names can only use letters, numbers, and . _ - (100 characters each)
translation: 所有者和仓库名称只能使用字母、数字和 . _ -（每段最多 100 个字符）

original: the old name will be reported as unreadable and the key will read as false: desktop extensions will be disabled until the name is updated
translation: 旧名称将被报告为无法读取，此键按 false 读取：桌面扩展会被禁用，直到更新名称

original: the old name will be reported as unreadable and not read, leaving the key unset: the extension directory will show and no directory-only install restriction will apply until the name is updated
translation: 旧名称将被报告为无法读取且不予读取，此键保持未设置：扩展目录会显示，且不限制仅从目录安装，直到更新名称

original: the old name will be reported as unreadable and the key will read as true: only signed extensions will load until the name is updated
translation: 旧名称将被报告为无法读取，此键按 true 读取：只加载已签名扩展，直到更新名称

original: no bootstrap request headers will be sent (the fetch may then fail to authenticate)
translation: 不会发送引导请求头（获取配置时可能因此无法通过身份验证）

original: the key will read as false (its fail-closed value): each user will be asked to consent to bootstrap-delivered sign-in targets, endpoints, helper scripts and connectors, even when the bootstrap URL came from a device-managed profile
translation: 此键将按 false 读取（出错时采用的限制值）：即使引导 URL 来自设备管理的配置，仍会要求每位用户同意引导配置提供的登录目标、端点、助手脚本和连接器

original: a scoped entry reaches Code sessions only, never Cowork; allow specific hosts with the egress host settings (coworkEgressAllowedHosts), one list for Cowork and Code
translation: 限定范围的条目只影响 Code 会话，不影响 Cowork；请通过出站主机设置（coworkEgressAllowedHosts）允许指定主机，同一个列表供 Cowork 和 Code 使用

original: looks like several rules joined by commas; use one entry per rule
translation: 看起来用逗号连接了多条规则；请为每条规则单独添加条目

original: malformed rule; expected Tool or Tool(pattern) on one line
translation: 规则格式错误；应在一行中填写 Tool 或 Tool(pattern)

original: the entry will be read as "ask" (approval on every call), like any unrecognized value
translation: 此条目将像任何无法识别的值一样按 "ask" 读取（每次调用都要求批准）

original: the key will read as false (its fail-closed value): end-user attribution will stay off — no identity shown, no enduser.id emitted — whatever the old name said
translation: 此键将按 false 读取（出错时采用的限制值）：无论旧名称的值如何，终端用户归属信息均保持关闭——不显示身份，也不发送 enduser.id

original: expected a UUID, or a JSON array of UUIDs such as ["<uuid>","<uuid>"]
translation: 应填写 UUID 或 UUID 的 JSON 数组，如 ["<uuid>","<uuid>"]

original: Claude Desktop 1.49585.0 or later on every device, then remove the key
translation: 所有设备均升级到 Claude Desktop 1.49585.0 或更高版本后，再删除此键

original: the value will be reported as an unreadable setting and the managed configuration will count as degraded until the key is removed; 1.46388 is the last release that reads it (later releases present TLS client certificates natively through Electron 44)
translation: 此值将被报告为无法读取的设置，托管配置会被标记为降级，直到删除此键；1.46388 是最后一个读取它的版本（后续版本通过 Electron 44 原生提供 TLS 客户端证书）

original: url, oauthIssuer and oauthClientId are required together (an import endpoint is unusable without all three)
translation: url、oauthIssuer 和 oauthClientId 必须同时设置（缺少任一字段时导入端点都无法使用）

original: must name at least one scope
translation: 必须指定至少一个权限范围

original: dropped: entries must be non-empty strings
translation: 已丢弃：条目必须是非空字符串

original: dropped: set builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy to "allow" to let Claude open every site
translation: 已丢弃：请将 builtinBrowserDefaultDomainPolicy 设为 "allow"，以允许 Claude 打开所有网站

original: matches nothing: localhost dev servers are never blocked in the built-in browser
translation: 不匹配任何目标：内置浏览器从不拦截 localhost 开发服务器

original: it is now read from Claude Code managed settings under the same name — deploy the replacement there
translation: 现在从 Claude Code 的托管设置中读取同名配置，请在那里部署替代设置

original: the Windows VM file-share fallback it switched was removed once Microsoft fixed the underlying Windows regression (KB5129195); nothing replaces it
translation: Microsoft 修复底层 Windows 问题（KB5129195）后，此键控制的 Windows VM 文件共享备用方案已移除，没有替代设置

original: the session host no longer reads it: a session there gets the tools the person's Claude Desktop serves whenever the organization's policy can be read, and a single tool, or every bridged server, is turned off with a managedMcpServers deny rule (the policy-only remote-devices row), while what the computer itself runs stays governed by isLocalDevMcpEnabled and the plugin server lists, except the local (stdio) MCP servers of plugins in the organization plugins directory, which start while the plugin is switched on unless a managed server has the same name; a session host older than that still reads it and treats absent as off, so remove it only once the session host has updated; nothing replaces it
translation: 会话主机不再读取此键：只要能读取组织策略，会话就使用该用户 Claude Desktop 提供的工具。可用 managedMcpServers 拒绝规则（仅策略的远程设备条目）禁用单个工具或所有桥接服务器。本机运行内容仍由 isLocalDevMcpEnabled 和插件服务器列表管理；但组织插件目录中的本地（stdio）MCP 服务器会在插件启用时启动，除非有同名托管服务器。较旧的会话主机仍读取此键，并在未设置时视为关闭，因此请等会话主机更新后再删除。没有替代设置。

original: the session host sign-in is always kept in the operating system's secure storage; nothing replaces it
translation: 会话主机登录信息始终存放在操作系统的安全存储中，没有替代设置
改用 inferenceCredentialKind（原值为 "interactive" 时，填写 "external-idp"）

original: Aliases like 'sonnet' are resolved via model discovery. Use the full model ID.
translation: 'sonnet' 等别名通过模型发现解析。请使用完整模型 ID。

original: Gateway baseUrl is an anthropic.com host but authScheme is not x-api-key. Consider switching to inferenceProvider: anthropic
translation: 网关 baseUrl 使用 anthropic.com 主机，但 authScheme 不是 x-api-key。建议改为 inferenceProvider: anthropic

original: No surface is enabled, so the app has nothing to open. Turn on at least one surface.
translation: 未启用任何界面，应用没有可打开的内容。请至少启用一种界面。

original: — the value must be a single JSON object string, not separate dotted keys
translation: ——此值必须是单个 JSON 对象字符串，不能使用分别设置的点分键

original: a name under another client's settings that this build does not know (left out of this build's copy)
translation: 此名称属于其他客户端的设置，当前版本无法识别（不纳入本版本的配置副本）

original: set by the hosted control plane from your organization; the configured value is ignored
translation: 由组织的托管控制平台设置，配置中的值将被忽略

original: not storable by the hosted control plane
translation: 无法由托管控制平台存储

original: not accepted from this configuration source
translation: 此配置来源不接受该设置

original: read by another client and not storable by the hosted control plane; left out
translation: 由其他客户端读取，托管控制平台无法存储，已排除

original: read by another client, which could not apply it as stored; kept unchanged
translation: 由其他客户端读取，无法按存储格式应用，保持原样

original: must be non-empty and must not contain a double quote ("), a percent sign (%) or a control character (in a registry or plist JSON string, write each backslash as \\)
translation: 不能为空，且不能包含双引号（"）、百分号（%）或控制字符（在注册表或 plist 的 JSON 字符串中，每个反斜杠都应写为 \\）

original: URL must not contain credentials or a backslash in the authority
translation: URL 的授权部分不能包含凭据或反斜杠

original: must not carry a query string or fragment
translation: 不能包含查询字符串或片段

original: Must be a version in X.Y.Z form, such as 1.2581.0
translation: 版本必须采用 X.Y.Z 格式，如 1.2581.0

original: dropped: not an accepted value — fix the spelling, or upgrade if this value was added in a newer Claude Desktop release
translation: 已丢弃：值不被接受——请检查拼写；如果该值是在较新版本中加入的，请升级 Claude Desktop

original: ignored: not a recognized sub-key — check the spelling, or upgrade if it was added in a newer Claude Desktop release
translation: 已忽略：无法识别的子键——请检查拼写；如果该子键是在较新版本中加入的，请升级 Claude Desktop

original: must be an http:// or https:// URL
translation: 必须是 http:// 或 https:// URL

original: must use https with a non-loopback host
translation: 必须使用 https，且主机不能是回环地址

original: must use https (or http on loopback)
translation: 必须使用 https（回环地址可使用 http）

original: must be one value with no spaces
translation: 必须是单个值，不能包含空格

original: must be an https URL, a host name, or a URI such as urn:…
translation: 必须是 https URL、主机名或 urn:… 等 URI

original: not an accepted value (expected allow, ask or blocked)
